abstract: We report the first experimental measurements of second-order polarization-mode dispersion in two successive 900 meter pulls of a silica photonic crystal fiber.

articleTitle: 800 GHz RF spectrum analyzer for optical signals
abstract: We demonstrate a conceptually new technique to measure the RF spectrum of an optical source. It provides extremely high bandwidth, is easily implemented with conventional off-the-shelf equipment and is therefore promising as a high-speed diagnostic.

articleTitle: Investigations on phase noise in a semiconductor mode-locked laser
abstract: Phase noise in an external cavity semiconductor mode-locked laser is investigated in view of the application of this pulse source for high bit rate data transmission, ultrafast switching and optical-sampling.

articleTitle: Lasing characteristics of optical thyristor for optical logic function
abstract: We present the first demonstration of the waveguide-type depleted optical thyristor laser diode with InGaAs/InGaAsP MQW structure. The lasing threshold current at the temperature of 25/spl deg/C and 10/spl deg/C are 111 mA and 72.5 mA, respectively.

articleTitle: Wavelength converter operating on strict frequency grid using a single side band optical modulator in a circulating loop
abstract: A wavelength converter and a variable wavelength light source that operate on strict frequency grid are proposed and demonstrated using a single side band optical modulator in a re-circulating fiber loop configuration.

articleTitle: Optical add/drop-outside and inside the box
abstract: This paper reviews the technology and applications of optical add/drop, concentrating on reconfigurable add/drop for next-generation systems. Representative designs will be presented, and discussed in terms of their flexibility, cascadability, scalability, impairments, and special features.

articleTitle: Packet-over-WDM demonstration and performance evaluation of baseband optical carrier-sense multiple access
abstract: We present the first WDM demonstration of baseband optical carrier-sense multiple access with collision avoidance. We evaluate the performance of the node through experiment and theory, showing excellent crosstalk performance and minimal power levels (<-50 dBm) for reliable operation.

articleTitle: Miniaturized Stokes polarimeter for high speed polarization measurements in optical communication networks
abstract: We present a new method for SOP measurement in optical fibers, designed for accurate and high speed SOP measurements and miniaturized package dimensions.

articleTitle: A low-cost, compact-size 10-Gigabit Ethernet optical sub-assembly using a novel opto-electronic hybrid integration platform
abstract: A novel opto-electronic hybrid integration platform using a flexible resin interposer on a silicon substrate has achieved low-cost, compact-size optical sub-assemblies. A 10 km error-free-transmission has been demonstrated with the optical sub-assemblies for 10-Gigabit Ethernet transceivers.

articleTitle: Monolithic mode-locked laser on GaInAsP/InP for 160 Gb/s TDM
abstract: Mode-locked laser OEICs on GaInAsP/InP for 160 Gb/s application in hybrid mode-locking operation are demonstrated with 40 GHz repetition rate, 2.4 ps pulse length, 230 fs timing jitter, and >1 mW fiber coupled power.

articleTitle: An experimental study of transmission distance limitation for the submarine cable system using C-band EDFA repeaters and a demonstration of 96 WDM, 10 Gbit/s, over 12,000 km transmission having sufficient engineering margin
abstract: We have experimentally evaluated transmission distance and capacity for the submarine cable system based on C-band EDFA repeater. About 1Tbit/s capacity is commercially realizable for the distance over 12,000km using high-gain FEC.

articleTitle: Small low-cost MU-receptacle 10-Gbit/s plastic optical receiver module with a three dimensional circuit structure
abstract: We newly developed a small low-cost surface-mount-type MU-receptacle 10-Gbit/s optical receiver module. A plastic package with a three-dimensional circuit structure, which enables highspeed operation inexpensively, is applied to the optical module for the first time.

articleTitle: Asymmetric stress distribution analysis on the polarization dependent loss in a CO/sub 2/ laser-written long period fiber grating
abstract: The effect of the stress-induced birefringence on the polarization-dependent transmission characteristics was thoroughly investigated for a long period fiber grating (LPFG) that was fabricated using a stress relaxation method with a CO/sub 2/ laser.

articleTitle: Internal electrode fiber polarization controller
abstract: With the growing importance of optics in access and metro networks, the need for inexpensive high-performance optical components becomes more acute. One of the essential functions required is polarization control. Manually, motorized or piezoelectric actuated controllers exist in the market, based on the stress induced in the fiber by an external element. In this paper, we present the principles and performance of a polarization controller based on the stress induced by an internal current driven electrode. Mach-Zehnder interferometer is used for implementing a 2/spl times/2 fiber switch.

articleTitle: A novel technique to determine second-order optical nonlinearity profiles
abstract: We report a novel technique to determine uniquely the second-order nonlinearity profile of nonlinear films. Applied to a thermally poled silica sample, it reveals a stronger coefficient d/sub 33/ (0.8 pm/V) than previously reported and important new profile features. Thermal poling is an interesting and potentially important technique used to induce a second-order optical nonlinearity in silica. This new and powerful technique is predicted to measure the nonlinearity and the nonlinearity profile of poled glasses and other nonlinear films.

articleTitle: Some approximate theory for switchable PMD compensation
abstract: Time-sharing PMD compensators between paths has the potential to substantially reduce compensation costs. In this paper, simple theory is presented which shows that simplifying assumptions like instantaneous switching can substantially underestimate provisioning requirements.

articleTitle: TM-pass electro-optic APC-CPW polymeric modulators with poling-induced waveguides and self-aligned electrodes
abstract: In this paper, TM-pass polymer Mach-Zehnder modulators with self-aligned electrodes were fabricated using a poling-induced writing method in APC-CPW1. A single-arm, 3-cm long electrode device shows a V/sub /spl pi// of 3.5 V. Measured driving voltages at 1.55 /spl mu/m show promising values, which could be further reduced by a push-pull electrode configuration.

articleTitle: Cladding pumping technology for L-band EDFAs
abstract: We analyze the performance of two types of L-band EDFAs based on cladding pumping technology. The amplifiers offer 30 dB gain over 1570-1607 nm spectral band with gain flatness of /spl plusmn/0.5 dB and noise figure below 5 dB.

articleTitle: Nondestructive characterization of the transverse profile of fiber Bragg gratings: influence on the polarization dependent properties
abstract: A technique is proposed to improve the signal-to-noise ratio of index modulation amplitude measurement along fiber Bragg gratings. The transverse profile is also visualized and reveals minute asymmetries. Their effect on spectral response and birefringence are investigated.

articleTitle: Life of a submarine cable from laboratory to seabed
abstract: This paper summarizes the three years life time of a long-haul submarine system, starting from the laboratory investigation and ending up with the on-site commissioning transmission tests.

articleTitle: An efficient all-fiber VOA with 30 kHz bandwidth and 10 mW drive power based on acousto-optic coupling on cladding etched single-mode fiber
abstract: We demonstrate a novel all-fiber ultra broadband VOA based on acousto-optic mode coupling in SM fiber with a dynamic range of 18 dB, PDL of 0.5 dB, bandwidth of 30 kHz and power consumption of 10 mW.

articleTitle: A compact, low resolution, wavelength monitor applied to Raman pump power monitoring
abstract: We demonstrate an ultra-compact, low cost coarse wavelength monitor. Wavelength resolution of 7 nm is achieved through core-radiation mode coupling of a tilted grating in photosensitive clad fiber. We applied the device to measure the powers of a multiwavelength source.

articleTitle: Generalized switching, splitting, and multiplexing operations using circular arrays of coupled waveguides
abstract: Nth-order coupled circular arrays of optical fibers can perform switching, splitting, and (de)multiplexing operations by adjusting the coupling between adjacent guides. A generalized 4-guide array to accomplish these operations is described, along with additional more specific results for higher-order systems.

articleTitle: The statistics of the frequency dependence of polarization mode dispersion in optical fibers
abstract: We study the statistics of spectral dependence of PMD. Conditional moments are analytically derived and a method for numerical generation of conditional distributions densities is presented. The numerical method can also be used to estimate system tolerance to high PMD.

articleTitle: Side-diffraction technique for highly accurate characterization of fiber Bragg grating index modulation
abstract: We demonstrate a technique for simultaneous measurement of fiber grating refractive index modulation (accuracy/spl sim/2/spl times/10/sup -6/) and grating period variation (accuracy/spl sim/5 pm) and apply our technique to direct calculation of chirped fiber grating group delay ripple.

articleTitle: Propagation in air by field superposition of scattered light within a Fresnel fibre
abstract: Propagation of light at 1.5mm along an air hole is achieved within an air-silica structured Fresnel waveguide where the holes are distributed along the Fresnel zones of the fibre. Fresnel lensing is reported.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum generation with mode-spacing of 154 GHz in 1460-1680 nm region from optical fiber by using actively mode-locked fiber laser
abstract: Wavelength-tunable supercontinuum with longitudinal mode spacing of 154 GHz is generated over 1460-1680 nm range. This becomes possible through the use of a higher-order mode-locked fiber laser, producing 900 fs pulses at 154 GHz rate, and a dispersion flattened fiber.

articleTitle: 50-dB nonlinear crosstalk suppression in a WDM analog fiber system by complementary modulation and balanced detection
abstract: By combining the previously-introduced modulated twin carriers technique with balanced detection, we have obtained up to 50-dB crosstalk reduction at low modulation frequencies, where crosstalk is the most severe, and in the most interesting region for cable television systems.

articleTitle: 2.5-Gb/s operation of monolithically integrated eight-channel WDM modulator module with 25-GHz channel spacing
abstract: We demonstrate an eight-channel WDM modulator module by packaging a monolithic multichannel WDM modulator chip with a 25-GHz spacing AWG, an SOA and an EAM-array. Successful operation under 2.5-Gb/s signals is achieved.

articleTitle: Optical beam forming of MM-wave array antennas in a 60 GHz radio over fiber system
abstract: We report on new results of a novel silica based signal processor for optical beam forming in wireless communication smart antenna systems. Basic components and measurements of an envisaged 60 GHz transmission system are described.

articleTitle: High co-directional Raman gain for 200-km spans, enabling 40 /spl times/ 10.66 Gb/s transmission over 2400 km
abstract: Using 200-km spans with 14.5-dB Raman co-gain, we transmitted 400 Gb/s error-free over 2400-km of True Wave/sup /spl reg// REACH fiber. With bidirectional Raman pumping, span lengths could be doubled, reducing operating expenses for medium-to long-haul systems.

articleTitle: Current status of perfluorinated GI-POF and 2.5 Gbps data transmission over it
abstract: We report the current status of perfluorinated graded index polymer optical fiber and its installation in premises. The capability to transmit data at more than 2.5 Gbps is also mentioned.

articleTitle: 160 to 40 Gb/s demultiplexing using a self-pulsating laser based clock recovery
abstract: Optical demultiplexing from 160 to 40 Gb/s is performed using a self-pulsating laser based clock recovery. Error free operation is obtained which demonstrates the good jitter characteristics of the optical clock.

articleTitle: 40 km passive optical metro-access ring (POMAR) including a protection scheme based on bi-directional fibers
abstract: We demonstrated a 40 km passive optical metro-access ring (POMAR) including 5 nodes able to carry up to 2/spl times/(16/spl times/2.5) Gbit/s without amplification. An original 1+1 protection scheme based on bi-directional fibers was implemented, not limited by the Rayleigh back scattering.

articleTitle: Drift-Free, 1000 G mechanical shock tolerant single-crystal silicon two-axis MEMS tilting mirrors in a 1000/spl times/1000-port optical crossconnect
abstract: We report drift-free two-axis tilting MEMS mirrors fabricated from single crystal silicon. These micromirrors survive 1000 G mechanical shocks and exhibit angular stability better than 4 millidegrees under simulated office vibrations. Two hermetically sealed mirror arrays were used to build a low-loss nonblocking 1000/spl times/1000-port optical cross-connect switch.

articleTitle: Dependence of DOP-based DGD monitors on the optical power spectrum of equal-pulse-width data formats
abstract: We demonstrate that the DGD monitoring range and sensitivity of PMD monitors is optical-spectrum-dependent in 10-and-40-Gbit/s CSRZ, ACRZ and RZ signals even when the pulse-widths are identical, and introduce a method to monitor PMD in CSRZ and ACRZ systems.

articleTitle: A comparative study of 10 Gb/s RZ-DPSK and RZ-ASK WDM transmission over transoceanic distances
abstract: We have experimentally compared RZ-DPSK with RZ-ASK for 100/spl times/10 Gb/s transmission over transoceanic distances. The Q degradation of RZ-DPSK due to nonlinearity effects after transmission over 9180 km was 3 dB larger than that of RZ-ASK.

articleTitle: 50 and 100 GHz multichannel tunable chromatic dispersion slope compensator
abstract: A novel grating-based multichannel tunable dispersion compensator is reported. The dispersion is settable on a per-channel basis to match a given dispersion slope. Both the absolute dispersion and the dispersion slope can be tuned thermally.

articleTitle: Uncooled, 10 Gb/s 1310 nm electroabsorption modulated laser
abstract: We demonstrate the first 10 Gb/s, 1310 nm EML operating uncooled from 0-85 /spl deg/C. Transmission over 20 km with zero power penalty and a 26% SONET eye-mask margin after 10 km are reported.

articleTitle: Dispersion monitoring and automatic compensation based on a differential nonlinear detection scheme
abstract: Using nonlinear optical detection to provide time-domain pulse distortion information and a novel differential measurement scheme to isolate the effect of chromatic dispersion and to determine its sign, real-time dispersion measurement and automatic compensation is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Adaptive 1 and 2 stage PMD-compensators for 40 Gbit/s transmission using eye monitor feedback
abstract: Optical PMD compensators with 1 and 2 stages using eye monitor feedback have been assessed experimentally. Applying statistical PMD with 35% of bitperiode the 2 stage compensator exhibits 2 dB penalty at 10-5 outage, 1.5 dB superior to 1 stage compensator.

articleTitle: Fibers and cables for ultralow PMD
abstract: Ultralow PMD in optical fibers and cables can be achieved by inducing a frozen in spin in the fiber. The fabrication and performance of "spun" fibers is reviewed.

articleTitle: 2R regeneration and simultaneous wavelength conversion using a fiber parametric amplifier and a semiconductor optical amplifier
abstract: 2R regeneration using a fiber parametric amplifier and a semiconductor amplifier has been demonstrated at 10 Gb/s with a 3.8 dB negative power penalty and significant extinction ratio improvement from 5 dB to 14 dB.

articleTitle: A dynamic lightpath setup solution based on 2-bit coded lambda state for WDM-routed networks
abstract: We propose a dynamic lightpath setup algorithm based on coded lambda states for WDM-routed networks. Analysis and simulation results show that this approach outperforms those of recent works in terms of blocking performance and complexity.

articleTitle: Temperature induced change in the dispersion spectrum of dispersion compensating fibers
abstract: Temperature dependence of the dispersion for DCF's is investigated. As oppose to a recent paper it is found that the change is mainly due to a translation of the dispersion spectrum similar transmission fibers.

articleTitle: High repetition-rate pulsed-pump fiber OPA for 10 Gb/s NRZ modulated signals
abstract: We demonstrated a pulsed-pump fiber optical parametric amplifier followed by a narrow optical filter for transparent signal amplification. Wide gain-bandwidth of 85 nm, large gain of 43 dB, and clear eye-opening were demonstrated for 10 Gb/s-NRZ signals by a 20 GHz asynchronous pulsed pump.

articleTitle: Optical signal processing with nonlinear fibers
abstract: The possible applications of nonlinear fibers to optical signal processing are described. Ultra-broad band/ultra-fast optical signal processing using optical Kerr-effects and super-continuum generation in nonlinear fibers are promising technologies for future photonic networks.

articleTitle: USA metropolitan network value opportunities
abstract: System costs of SONET, next-generation SONET and WDM transparent ring with 2.5 and 10 Gb/s bit rates are compared for metro applications. WDM ring technology offers significant cost reduction compared to other approaches.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of single-section PMD compensators using multiple importance sampling
abstract: We compare the performance of single-section polarization mode dispersion (PMD) compensators with either a fixed- or variable-differential group delay (DGD) element as a function of both first- and second-order PMD using multiple importance sampling. We show that there is little benefit in using a variable-DGD element.

articleTitle: Demonstration of optical burst data switching using photonic MPLS routers operated by GMPLS signaling
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, optical burst data switching using photonic MPLS routers controlled by GMPLS. Optical burst data can be transmitted at a bit rate of 10 Gb/s without burst data loss, and high network throughput is achieved.

articleTitle: On the scalability of adjustable high-order mode fiber dispersion compensators
abstract: We present a study of loss and MPI contributions from various components in adjustable dispersion compensators utilizing HOM fibers. We demonstrate this technology scalability to offer fine dispersion tuning granularity while maintaining low loss and low MPI characteristics.

articleTitle: Calculating PMD statistics and outage probabilities with importance sampling
abstract: This paper describes the application of importance sampling to Monte-Carlo simulations of polarization-mode dispersion (PMD) in optical fibers. We have shown that importance sampling biases Monte-Carlo simulations of concatenated birefringent sections so that large first-and/or second-order PMD values occur more frequently than they would normally. The method also allows the effect of PMD on system outage probabilities to be assessed at realistic levels. PMD can be a major impairment in optical transmission systems. To first order in frequency, PMD splits a pulse between the fast and slow fiber axes; at the same time, higher-order PMD induces depolarization and polarization-dependent chromatic dispersion. We have shown that importance sampling biases Monte-Carlo simulations of concatenated birefringent sections so that large first-and/or second-order PMD values occur more frequently than they would normally. Importance-sampled Monte-Carlo techniques thus provide a natural and effective tool to assess PMD statistics and PMD-induced impairments in optical transmission systems at realistic probability levels.

articleTitle: Interconnection of metropolitan and backbone networks
abstract: As Internet traffic continues to grow, eventually dominating voice traffic, the network economics and traffic granularities may become favorable for merging the metropolitan core with the long-distance backbone network, to form an integrated 10 Gb/s wavelength-routed network architecture.

articleTitle: RF phase distortion due to crosstalk in an 8 channel wavelength division multiplexed analog delay line
abstract: We present experimental results of crosstalk for an eight channel WDM 25 microsecond delay line. The total phase error produced by the crosstalk onto one channel from the other seven over a frequency of 0-20 GHz is measured.

articleTitle: Measurement techniques for high-speed WDM experiments
abstract: Using the correct measurement techniques for high-speed WDM experiments ensure that lab-results accurately reflect real system performance. In this paper we summarize experimental best practices and review how improper measurement techniques can lead to misleading results.

articleTitle: Dispersion managed spans in terrestrial routes: technical advantages and practical considerations
abstract: Dispersion managed spans can provide bit-rate independent performance and economic advantages in terrestrial routes. Recent work is showing that they can be cabled and spliced in field-like conditions and proper system design can accommodate imperfect and random dispersion maps.

articleTitle: Ultra-wideband tellurite-based fiber Raman amplifiers
abstract: We review recent research on ultra-wide-band tellurite-based fiber Raman amplifiers and discuss their future prospects. These amplifiers are superior to silica-based fiber Raman amplifiers in that they provide wideband operation with short fibers and only a few pump LDs.

articleTitle: Wideband compression-tuned all-fibre DFB laser: analysis and characterisation
abstract: The optical output from an all-fibre DFB-laser compression tuned over most of the C-band is analysed and characterised. The single-polarisation and line-width performance of the device is maintained across the full tuning range.

articleTitle: Channelized dispersion compensator with flat pass bands using an array of deformable MEMS mirrors
abstract: Continuously variable and independently addressable channelized dispersion is produced by an array of MEMS adaptable curvature mirrors employed in a novel optical configuration. A per channel variable dispersion greater than +/-400ps/nm was demonstrated, with 56 GHz +/-0.4 dB flat passband on 85 GHz spacing.

articleTitle: Novel modulation techniques
abstract: We demonstrate superior performance of phase shift-keying (PSK) modulation format versus conventional on-off keying (OOK) format. Binary PSK yields 4.2 dB SNR improvement. Quadrature PSK format allows DWDM transmission over 1000 km at 0.8 bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Greater than 90nm continuously wavelength-tunable fibre Bragg gratings
abstract: In this paper silica-based fibre Bragg grating filters with wavelength tuning-spans well over 90nm using a simple set-and-forget beam bending tuning-package is reported. The key operational parameters of the filters are maintained over the entire tuning-window.

articleTitle: 1 Watt 14xy InGaAsP/InP ridge waveguide pump laser diodes with low vertical farfield and high efficiency
abstract: We present 14/spl deg/ vertical farfield 14xy InGaAsP/InP ridge-waveguide pump lasers with >1 W CW output-power and 28% power conversion efficiency optimized by comprehensive multidimensional modeling without need for sophisticated materials or processes. Fiber coupled power reaches more than 450 mW.

articleTitle: Advance in long-haul fibers
abstract: Dramatic increase in transmission systems capacity has recently been reported in long-haul terrestrial transmission systems. This paper will review advances in transmission and compensating fibers that opened the door to such transmission capability improvements.

articleTitle: High speed (40-160 Gbit/s) WDM transmission in terrestrial networks
abstract: High-speed WDM transmission for terrestrial EDFA-based systems including field trial of 63/spl times/40 Gbit/s transmission using 320 km (4/spl times/80 km) installed NZ-DSFs and 4/spl times/160 Gbit/s transmission over 225 km is reviewed.

articleTitle: An efficient technique for finding input SOPs, which maximize/minimize the eye- opening in fiber-optic links with high-order PMD and PDL
abstract: A novel and efficient technique for finding the input states of polarization, which maximize/minimize the eye-opening in fiber-optic communication systems affected with high order PMD and PDL, is introduced and numerically validated.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of in-service dispersion monitoring in the whole transmission bandwidth of WDM systems by optical frequency-modulation method
abstract: We propose and demonstrate the in-service monitor of the dispersion within the entire transmission bandwidth by applying the optical frequency-modulation method at a few WDM channels. This method has potential applications to cost-effective adaptive dispersion compensation in ultra-dense WDM systems.

articleTitle: Precise calibration for optical amplifier noise figure measurement using the RIN subtraction method
abstract: Calibration with a relative-intensity noise (RIN) standard significantly improves the RIN subtraction method for measuring the noise figure of an erbium-doped fiber amplifier (EDFA). The typical standard uncertainty in our measurement is /spl les/0.15 dB.

articleTitle: A study on gain modulation dynamics of 80 nm-band high-power Raman amplifier
abstract: We have studied the gain modulation characteristics of 80 nm-band high-power backward-pumped Raman amplifier. We found that flat gain modulation response was obtained over the entire signal bandwidth by intensity-modulating the longest-wavelength pump light source at a frequency higher than 10 kHz.

articleTitle: High-spectral-efficiency DWDM access network supporting 10-Gbps access services
abstract: A DWDM access network that supports 10-Gbps services is presented. The network scalability is numerically clarified by using 4-ary ASK, which achieves the spectral efficiency of 0.8 bps/Hz as compared to conventional NRZ.

articleTitle: Consistency in gain spectra of erbium doped fibers
abstract: A parameter is defined to monitor variations in spectral response of Erbium-doped fibers. Production statistics are given for more than one Mm EDF. The standard deviation is 0.7%, attained by using highly optimized production equipment.

articleTitle: Comparison of return-to-zero phase shift keying and on-off keying in long haul dispersion managed transmissions
abstract: RZ-DPSK in DWDM dispersion managed transmission is studied experimentally and compared with OOK in a 10 Gb/s system. OOK out-performs PSK in a low spectral efficiency system. At 10 Gb/s transmission with 50 GHz channel separation, however, RZ-OOK and RZ-DPSK performances are comparable. RZ-PSK is advantageous in a high spectral efficiency system and results are shown of numerical studies of several PSK systems with high spectral efficiencies and long system reach.

articleTitle: Integrated performance monitoring PLC circuit for WDM system
abstract: An integrated performance monitoring PLC circuit based on a double-resolution-AWG-based power monitoring circuit concatenating with a tunable periodic notch filter is proposed and demonstrated. It achieves wavelength, power and high dynamic range OSNR monitoring functionalities on a single chip.

articleTitle: Effects of SPM and PMD on chromatic dispersion monitoring techniques using pilot tones
abstract: We investigated the effects of SPM and PMD on chromatic dispersion monitoring techniques using pilot tones. The technique based on phase-modulated pilot tones is relatively insensitive to SPM and PMD, thus provides superior performance to technique using amplitude-modulated pilot tones.

articleTitle: Scaling rules for Raman fiber lasers
abstract: Scaling rules for Raman fiber lasers are presented, which provide a possibility to linearly re-scale any Raman fiber laser design to any other fiber, and to directly compare the suitability and cost-effectiveness of different standard and Raman-optimized fibers.

articleTitle: Tunable dispersion slope compensator based on chirped FBGs with temperature distribution for 160 Gbit/s
abstract: Tunable dispersion slope compensator based on FBGs is presented, which can be tuned precisely with parabolic temperature distribution. Using this device, 160 Gbit/s signals are transmitted over 140 km within 1 dB power penalty.

articleTitle: PMD emulation with importance sampling and Maxwellian length sections
abstract: We describe the application of importance sampling to PMD emulators consisting of a concatenation of birefringent sections with Maxwellian-distributed lengths. Use of this scheme offers significant advantages over emulators with fixed-length sections.

articleTitle: Advanced amplifier design: physics and systems limitations
abstract: We discuss the design requirements of transient gain-controlled erbium-doped fiber amplifiers for next generation photonic networks, possible design implementation and trade-offs.

articleTitle: Widely tunable laser module using DFB array and MEMs selection with internal wavelength locker
abstract: We describe a C-band tunable module using a DFB laser array and a MEMs mirror for laser selection. The module incorporates an internal wavelength-locker and a closed-loop mirror positioning servo to ensure stable operation.

articleTitle: Anticipating on future evolutions during the network planning process
abstract: This paper indicates the importance of using long-term traffic predictions in the network planning process. In the described case study, the proposed anticipated planning methodology leads to cost savings of 7% compared to traditional approaches.

articleTitle: Characterization of dispersion in higher order mode fibers using electrical spectrum measurements
abstract: We present a technique for measuring the chromatic dispersion of the higher order modes in kilometer lengths of fiber. The LP/sub 02/ dispersion is measured for several different fibers, and accuracies better than 1% are achieved.

articleTitle: Macroscopic and microscopic thermal management of a planar integrated optical device
abstract: We present a detailed concept for microscopic and macroscopic thermal management of a planar, integrated optical device. Deep-etched grooves minimize the power consumption of thermo-optical switches. The layout minimize thermal crosstalk between different components.

articleTitle: All-optical sub-carrier label swapping with 2R regeneration
abstract: We propose and demonstrate an all-optical sub-carrier label-swapping subsystem with 2R regeneration and wavelength conversion. The experimental results show error-free operation as well as regenerating operation with negative power penalty.

articleTitle: Fast wavelet collocation method for WDM system parameter optimization
abstract: Using a wavelet collocation method, which is substantially faster than the standard split-step Fourier method, accurate optimizations of WDM system parameters become possible. For a typical 40-Gbit/s system, the optimum power level is determined and compared to analytical approximations.

articleTitle: Whatever happened to fiber-to-the-home?
abstract: The early vision of FTTH, which promised abundant, ubiquitous, and future-proof bandwidth to consumers, has remained largely unrealized nearly 20 years after its birth. We discuss the historical, competitive, economic, and service reasons for this and prospects for the future.

articleTitle: Operation margin of all-optical regenerator at 40-Gbit/s by SOA-based polarization discriminated switch
abstract: We have experimentally investigated the operation margin of all-optical regenerator by SOA-based polarization discriminated switch at 40 Gbit/s. The tolerances against power variance and timing deviation of the input data signals were evaluated in detail.

articleTitle: FULL-RCMA: a high utilization EPON
abstract: This paper proposes a novel medium access control protocol for Ethernet passive optical networks. Its efficiency is evaluated by simulation: that demonstrate that 95% utilization can be achieved under heavy load conditions.

articleTitle: Transmission of 1.6 Tb/s (40/spl times/42.7 Gb/s) over transoceanic distance with terrestrial 100-km amplifier spans
abstract: Forty 42.7-Gb/s, 100-GHz-spaced WDM channels were transmitted over 6000 km of Ultra-Wave/spl trade/ fiber using 100-km dispersion-managed fiber spans. This is the first transoceanic length DWDM demonstration at 40 Gb/s using terrestrial amplifier span lengths.

articleTitle: 5,745 km DWDM transcontinental field trial using 10 Gbit/s dispersion managed solitons and dynamic gain equalization
abstract: Error free unregenerated transmission is demonstrated looped-back over 5,745 km (62 spans) of installed SSMF along the Adelaide-Perth leg of the IP1 Australia network, which is now the world's longest commercially deployed unregenerated 10 Gbit/s DWDM terrestrial transmission system.

articleTitle: 320-Gbit/s error-free demultiplexing operation of a monolithic PD-EAM optical gate
abstract: This paper presents 320-Gbit/s error-free demultiplexing operation (receiver sensitivity: -18 dBm) of an ultrafast optical gate that monolithically integrates a uni-traveling-carrier photodiode and a traveling-wave electroabsorption modulator (PD-EAM).

articleTitle: Photonic crystal polarization beam splitters and their applications: first industrialization of photonic crystal devices
abstract: We have developed novel polarization beam splitters consisting of photonic crystals and proved several attractive properties. We report their characteristics and several practical applications such as an isolator, a polarization beam combiner, and a state-of-polarization sensor.

articleTitle: Multiwavelength, actively mode-locked polarization maintaining fiber laser at 10 GHz
abstract: We demonstrate a multiwavelength actively mode-locked polarization maintaining fiber laser at 10 GHz. Stable generation of 13-wavelength short pulses was demonstrated by cooling the erbium-doped fiber in liquid nitrogen.

articleTitle: Properties of directional couplers using photonic crystal waveguides
abstract: Coupled photonic crystal waveguides have been designed and modelled with a 3D finite-difference-time-domain method, and fabricated in silicon-on-insulator material. Good agreement between modelled and measured results has been found.

articleTitle: Broadband, wide dynamic range liquid crystal devices
abstract: Compact optical devices, covering both C and L bands with over 50 dB dynamic range, are realized using a single liquid crystal cell with a thin layer of tilted fused silica coating compensating its small residual birefringence.

articleTitle: Suppression of temperature and polarization dependence by polymer overcladding in silica-based AWG multiplexer
abstract: A temperature and polarization-insensitive arrayed waveguide grating (AWG) multiplexer was realized by forming a polymer overcladding with negative thermo-optic coefficient on the silica core and undercladding without deteriorating the loss and crosstalk characteristics of the original silica AWG multiplexer.

articleTitle: Timing jitter tolerant all-optical TDM data demultiplexing at 80Gbit/s using fiber Bragg grating based rectangular pulse switching technology
abstract: We demonstrate the use of fiber Bragg grating based pulse-shaping technology for timing-jitter tolerant data demultiplexing in an 80Gbit/s OTDM system. Error-free demultiplexing operation with /spl sim/6ps jitter-tolerance is achieved, showing a 2dB power-penalty improvement compared to demultiplexing without the grating.

articleTitle: Above 100 GHz performance of waveguide integrated photodiodes measured by electro-optical sampling
abstract: An excellent linear power and phase response up to frequencies of 160 GHz is demonstrated on ultrafast waveguide integrated photodetectors, by means of the electro-optical sampling method.

articleTitle: Micromechanical wavelength add/drop switching: from device to network architecture
abstract: Microelectro-mechanical (MEMS) components can play a surprisingly diverse role in add/drop switching, ranging from simple 2-port tunable filters to large port-count crossconnects assembled from wavelength selective switches. I will review the various kinds of MEMS switch components and show the wavelength add/drop architectures they enable.

articleTitle: Fiber optical parametric amplifier in WDM applications
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time experimentally the performance of fiber-based optical parametric amplifiers in WDM applications. Limitations due to pump depletion and four-wave mixing are quantified.

articleTitle: Full wavelength dependence of Raman gain in optical fibers: measurements using a single pump laser
abstract: The dependence of the Raman gain on both the absolute pump wavelength and the signal-pump wavelength difference can be determined using a simple method that relies on a single pump laser, broadband source, and OSA.

articleTitle: Chirp measurement of electro-optic modulators using simple optical spectrum analysis
abstract: A novel method to measure chirp parameters of electro-optic modulators using optical spectrum analysis is demonstrated. Both the chirp parameter and high-frequency half-wave voltage can be readily obtained from the variation of optical spectrum as the bias voltage varies.

articleTitle: Computing optically disjoint paths for survivable all-optical networks
abstract: We consider the problem of finding two paths for given wavelength channels in the network such that one of them remains available in the event of an optical attack by addition of minimal optoelectronic equipment.

articleTitle: Frequency offset tolerance between optical source and delay interferometer in DPSK and DQPSK systems
abstract: We assess, both by measurement and simulation, the receiver performance degradation caused by frequency offsets between the optical source and the delay interferometer for NRZ and RZ, DPSK and DQPSK systems.

articleTitle: Intermediate node initiated (INI) signalling: a hybrid resevation technique for optical burst-switched networks
abstract: We introduce a new reservation scheme, intermediate node initiation, which provides the functionality of both TAW and JET in the same network. INI scheme provides a trade-off between end-to-end delay and burst loss, enabling support for different classes of traffic.

articleTitle: Highly-reliable operation of DFB laser modules with integrated wavelength monitor
abstract: The use of YAG welding and soldering techniques for fixing optical components made it possible to achieve average wavelength drift of less than /spl plusmn/2 pm during tests, which can be applicable for 25 GHz channel spacing DWDM system.

articleTitle: Demonstration of dynamic self-routing in an all-optical burst switched mesh network with four optical label switch routers
abstract: Self-routing of three 10Gbit/s optical burst signals has been successfully demonstrated in an all-optical mesh network with four 2/spl times/2 optical label switch routers. No optical burst frame loss was found at up to 40% traffic load.

articleTitle: Fully reconfigurable, 20 channel optical add-/drop multiplexer with integrated variable optical attenuators and power monitors
abstract: We present a highly integrated, reconfigurable optical add-/drop multiplexer. A single planar silica/silicon substrate serves as integration platform for arrayed waveguide gratings, switch matrix, attenuators and photodiodes of the 20 channel device.

articleTitle: Low-loss integrated-optic dynamic chromatic dispersion compensators using lattice-form planar lightwave circuits
abstract: We propose novel techniques for measuring lattice-form PLCs without monitor waveguides. We employed them to develop polarization-insensitive dynamic dispersion compensators with a dispersion variability of -150 /spl sim/ +150 ps/nm and a low loss of 4.2 dB for 50 GHz-bandwidth.

articleTitle: Electrically tunable free-space sub-wavelength grating filters with 30nm tuning range
abstract: We demonstrated a new class of electrically tunable filters, which is based on a waveguide resonant sub-wavelength grating filter incorporating a tuning mechanism. They are ideally suited for applications in dynamic feedback loops, optical performance monitoring, and reconfigurable add/ drop multiplexers.

articleTitle: Pulse distortion induced by combined effects of PMD and PDL in optical transmission systems
abstract: The combined effects of PMD and PDL on pulse broadening are studied. We show that PDL considerably reduces the efficiency of PMD compensation, due to increased higher order PMD in the presence of PDL.

articleTitle: An all-fiber WDM channel monitor based on acousto-optic tunable filter with built-in on-fiber detector
abstract: An all-fiber WDM channel monitor based on narrowband AOTF and on-fiber detector is demonstrated. By employing FSK modulation scheme, intrinsic wavelength accuracy of 0.02 nm is obtained for single channel detection and 0.05 nm for multiple channel detection.

articleTitle: Capacity requirements for network recovery from node failure with dynamic path restoration
abstract: Node failure is not as frequent as span failure but recent events have emphasized its importance in network planning. We study the effects on capacity design if full or partial recovery from node failures is provided using failure-specific path restoration.

articleTitle: Gain characteristics of thulium-doped tellurite fiber amplifiers by dual-wavelength (800nm+1064 nm) pumping
abstract: We demonstrate that simultaneously pumping a thulium-doped tellurite fiber amplifier with 800nm and 1064nm significantly increases the achievable gain. A gain of 26dB and noise figure less than 4dB were obtained with a 1.5m doped fiber length.

articleTitle: Technique for in-situ measurements of polarization mode dispersion
abstract: A nondisruptive PMD measurement technique (utilizing the sidebands of working channels) is demonstrated, compared to the Mueller matrix method, and applied to a 43Gb/s field-installed system. Correlation between differential group delay and bit-error rate is observed.

articleTitle: All-SOP all-fiber depolarizer linear design
abstract: A novel single mode fiber depolarizer is demonstrated, based on a 3 dB coupler in association with polarization combiners. Wide spectral band operation and low degree of polarization (5%) are obtained for 0/spl deg/C to 70/spl deg/C temperature range.

articleTitle: Complete simulating tool for all-optical high bit-rate signal processing schemes based on noisy SOAs
abstract: A numerical prediction of the noisy SOAs behavior along with the injected current dependence is presented and experimentally validated. The proposed modeling is suitable for analysis of all-optical signal processing schemes at high bit-rate.

articleTitle: Cost-effective WDM backbone network design with OXCs of different bandwidth granularities
abstract: We propose a framework for designing a WDM backbone network with OXCs of different grooming granularities. Numerical examples are presented showing that granularity-heterogeneous networks are more cost-effective than granularity-homogeneous networks.

articleTitle: Gain-clamped thulium-doped fiber amplifier with a single pump at 1050nm
abstract: The large homogeneous bandwidth of thulium-doped fiber amplifier makes it suitable for optical gain clamping. This is demonstrated experimentally with gain variation of 1.2dB for 15dB input dynamic range, less than 1dB gain ripple over 20nm, without noise figure degradation.

articleTitle: Low nonlinearity bismuth oxide-based erbium-doped fiber amplifiers for short pulse amplification
abstract: We compare the nonlinearity tolerance of a conventional silica-based fiber amplifier and a bismuth-based fiber amplifier. The bismuth-based amplifier has shown superior performance over the conventional amplifier for short pulse amplification.

articleTitle: Beyond 1 kW with fiber lasers and amplifiers
abstract: We report recent progress and future prospects of high-power fiber sources in the 1 and 1.5 /spl mu/m spectral ranges, with a 103 W, 1565 nm erbium-ytterbium doped fiber laser as an example. Our emphasis is on diode stack pumping and short fibers with high Brillouin thresholds.

articleTitle: Shared sub-path protection with overlapped protection areas in WDM networks
abstract: A partitioning configuration that divides a given network into overlapped protection areas for shared sub-path protection is investigated. The performances of capacity requirement and restoration time are improved without any significant degradation of other performances.

articleTitle: Dependence of nonlinear phase shift on cavity length of SOA for all-optical signal processing
abstract: The cavity-length dependence of the nonlinear-phase-shift of semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA) phase shifters was experimentally investigated for a symmetric-Mach-Zehnder-type wavelength-converter for the first time. Studies of 42-GHz-cross-phase-modulation of SOAs showed that the phase-shift increased almost proportionally with active region length.

articleTitle: A distributed collision avoidance protocol using pilot tone-based carrier sense mechanism for passive optical networks
abstract: A distributed collision-avoidance scheme employing pilot-tone based carrier sensing mechanism is proposed for the upstream multiaccess in PONs. Simulation results show the proposed algorithm outperforms the conventional CSMA/CD scheme in terms of network throughput and delay.

articleTitle: 1.6 Tb/s (40/spl times/40 Gb/s) transmission over 1200 km of field-deployed dispersion-managed fiber
abstract: We demonstrated 40/spl times/40 Gb/s all-Raman NRZ transmission over 1200 km of field-deployed dispersion-managed fiber. Precise dispersion slope matching and low temperature sensitivity eliminated the need of per-channel and dynamic dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: High-performance all-optical gain-controlled two-stage erbium-doped fiber amplifier for bi-directional transmission
abstract: A novel all-optical gain-controlled two-stage EDFA for bi-directional transmission is proposed. The structure achieves high and constant gain independent of input signal power and low noise figure. The structure also removes Rayleigh back-scattered light.

articleTitle: Removal of the dispersion limitations in FBG filters using a thin-film based allpass device
abstract: Dispersion compensation of a 100 GHz FBG bandpass filter using a thin-film based device is reported. The device consists of two coupled two-cavity allpass filters in a parallel configuration, requiring only two reflections.

articleTitle: Online control-message scheduling for quality of protection (QoP) in DWDM mesh networks
abstract: Lightpaths in a mesh network may have different restoration time requirements. We show that a priority-based scheduling algorithm incorporated into the restoration signaling protocol can restore significantly higher proportion of connections within the QoP requirements.

articleTitle: Technologies for dynamic gain and power equalization
abstract: The next generation long haul and/or higher-bit-rate systems will require dynamic compensation of amplifier gain profiles and channel powers. This talk will review and compare the available technologies for implementing these functions.

articleTitle: Lithographically scribed, focusing, planar holographic Bragg reflector with 17-GHz-passband and 0.3 cm/sup 2/ footprint
abstract: A focusing holographic Bragg reflector in a slab waveguide is demonstrated to provide 17 GHz, essentially Fourier-transform-limited, spectral resolution and nearly diffraction-limited, spatial-beam mapping in a device footprint of only 0.3 cm/sup 2/.

articleTitle: Transient gain dynamics in saturated Raman amplifiers with multiple counter-propagating pumps
abstract: A new block diagram of Raman amplifiers with multiple backward pumps is proposed, for use in commercial simulators. Transient computation times are shorter by more than an order of magnitude as compared with the full solution of the propagation equations.

articleTitle: A covariance matrix method for calculating accurate bit error rates in a DWDM chirped RZ system
abstract: We present a covariance matrix method to compute accurate error rates in a 10Gb/s DWDM chirped RZ transmission systems with channels spaced 50GHz apart at the computational cost of only 280 Monte Carlo noise realizations.

articleTitle: Low temperature-sensitive waveguide Bragg grating using Ge, B, F-doped SiO/sub 2/ films
abstract: A B-SiO/sub 2/ core waveguide with UV-induced Bragg grating on multicomponent crystallized glass substrate is fabricated. A temperature dependence of the Bragg wavelength as low as 4pm/K, which is 1/3 of a conventional device, is achieved.

articleTitle: MultiTHz wavelength conversion by four wave mixing and cross gain modulation in an InAs/InP quantum dash semiconductor optical amplifier operating at 1550 nm
abstract: We describe multiTHz wavelength conversion in a 1550 nm InAs/InP quantum dash semiconductor optical amplifier using four wave mixing and cross gain modulation. Short pulses as well as data sequences were converted.

articleTitle: Photonic bandgap microcavity devices
abstract: Modern semiconductor microfabrication techniques can be used to define the high quality optical components needed in nanophotonic integrated circuits. Here we show our work on design, fabrication and characterization of ultrasmall lasers, filters, modulators and waveguides in photonic crystals.

articleTitle: 25-GHz spacing all-Raman transmission of 192 WDM channels at 10.66 Gb/s over 30/spl times/22 dB of TW-RS fiber
abstract: Using all Raman amplification with 10 dB of co-propagating distributed gain we demonstrate 25 GHz spacing transmission of 1.92 Tb/s (192/spl times/10.66 Gb/s) over 30/spl times/22 dB spans of TW-RS fiber.

articleTitle: Fabrication and wavelength adjustment of a WDM gain-coupled DFB laser array with a superlattice trimming layer
abstract: Post-fabrication wavelength trimming by photoabsorption-induced disordering of a superlattice has been demonstrated for the first time in 1.55 /spl mu/m three-channel gain-coupled distributed-feedback laser array. Its unequal channel spacing as fabricated has successfully been corrected to 100GHz (0.8 nm) equal spacing.

articleTitle: Quantum limit of direct-detection receivers: duobinary vs. IMDD
abstract: We demonstrate that the quantum limit of direct-detection receivers using duobinary transmission can exceed that of IMDD by 0.91 dB and we show that a practical optical duobinary system implementation can closely approach such performance.

articleTitle: Real-time characterization of short optical pulse using spectrograms
abstract: The complete characterization of 40 Gb/s train of optical pulses is performed in real time using spectrograms. This tool competes very favorably with electronic sampling scopes in term of bandwidth and is used for real-time optimization.

articleTitle: New cyclic wavelength routers using diffraction grating for CWDM or DWDM networks
abstract: We designed new static cyclic N*N wavelength permutation switches based on 2N/spl times/N noncyclic routers accurately matched to the ITU CWDM grid for metro applications. On 16/spl times/16 20 nm spacing components the maximum channel deviation is 0.57 nm.

articleTitle: InGaAs/AlAs/AlAsSb coupled quantum intersubband transition all-optical switch with low switching energy for OTDM
abstract: We report a novel absorptive intersubband transition all-optical switch with low switching energy using InGaAs/AlAs/AlAsSb coupled quantum wells. Very low saturation energy density of 34 fJ//spl mu/m/sup 2/ and switching energy of 10 pJ for 10 dB extinction ratio were observed.

articleTitle: Optimised pulse compression of 40 Gbit/s pulses using frequency resolved optical gating
abstract: The use of frequency resolved optical gating measurements to simplify the design and optimization of an 80 Gbit/s pulse source, based on a 40 Gbit/s externally modulated CW laser diode followed by a nonlinear fiber compressor and multiplexer, is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Structured LDPC codes for high-speed long-haul optical communications
abstract: We present a class of structured LDPC codes based on mutually orthogonal Latin rectangles having high code rates, high girth and very low complexity encoder/decoder implementations suitable for high-speed long-haul optical communications.

articleTitle: Improvement of estimated splice loss accuracy by measuring MFD of spliced fiber
abstract: Estimated splice loss accuracy has been improved. The splicer has been improved to measure the mode field diameter (MFD) of the spliced fiber, and estimate the MFD mismatch loss accurately. This improvement is useful for dissimilar fiber splicing.

articleTitle: Resonances and modal cutoff in microstructured optical waveguides
abstract: We show that the spectral properties of microstructured fibers and waveguides are determined by the geometry of high-index inclusions and can be predicted from the cutoff condition for the highest order mode of the high index inclusion.

articleTitle: 160Gb/s to l0Gb/s OTDM demultiplexing using a traveling-wave electroabsorption modulator
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time direct 160Gb/s to 10Gb/s demultiplexing using one electrically-gated electroabsorption modulator. No indication of an error floor was observed. The power penalty for the worst channel is less than 1.5dB. We believe that the current limitation of alternating polarization multiplexing can be removed if the quality of the transmitter pulse can be improved.

articleTitle: Photolithographic sol-gel materials with high resolution and optical transparency for waveguides
abstract: Novel polysiloxane-based materials with high resolution and optical transparency have been developed. The optical waveguides with precise core patterns have been fabricated using photolithographic technique and indicated low propagation losses at 1.310 and 1.550 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: "Holey" optical fibers: cages for light
abstract: Optical fibers with air holes in their cross-section can deliver previously unimaginable performance. They represent an alternative fiber technology which is at a relatively early stage of development, but which can already outperform conventional fibers in certain respects. Photonic crystal fibers provide a wonderful arena for scientists in disciplines such as nonlinear optics and fiber design.

articleTitle: New type of positive medial dispersion fiber (P-MDF/sup 150/) with dispersion as 10 ps/nm/km and Aeff about 150 /spl mu/m/sup 2/
abstract: New type of positive medial dispersion fiber with suppressed dispersion as 10 ps/nm/km and enlarged Aeff about 150 /spl mu/m/sup 2/ (P-MDF/sup 150/) has been developed successfully. Ultra large equivalent Aeff as 100 /spl mu/m/sup 2/ was obtained keeping low dispersion slope and low accumulated dispersion in total.

articleTitle: Bias-induced diversity-detection (BIDD) technique for robust transmission of subcarrier-multiplexed channels
abstract: We demonstrate CD and PMD robust SCM. The modulator is low-biased, and we have diversity from first and second harmonics. We reduce the CD fading from 40 to <6-dB, and the 5% PMD tail fading from 40 to <12-dB.

articleTitle: New method for the air blown fiber bundle
abstract: In air blown fiber system, the fiber bundles must be carefully manufactured so they feed through the blowing head and slide along the installed tubes without lubricant. In this paper, the package materials and the process for ABF are studied. The UV curable coating material makes it possible to produce ABF optical bundle faster and cheaper than conventional thermal process.

articleTitle: 1415-1505 nm quasicontinuously tunable pulse source based on fibre-optic parametric oscillation
abstract: A 1415-1505 nm quasicontinuously tunable picosecond pulse source is demonstrated with 6-50 pJ pulse energy, which is implemented on a synchronously pumped fibre-optic parametric oscillator with a dispersion flattened fibre gain section embedded.

articleTitle: Influence of wavelength and temperature changes on optical performance of fiber joints
abstract: We investigated the characteristics of various types of fiber joint contact. When there is an air gap between fiber ends, the optical performance becomes dependent on wavelength. The reflections at joints where there is index-matching material are influenced by temperature.

articleTitle: 800 Gb/s (20/spl times/40 Gb/s) C-band transmission over 900 km of dispersion shifted fiber
abstract: We report 40 Gb/s propagation results over 10 spans (900 km) of dispersion-shifted fiber. This performance is achieved using CS-RZ modulation, FWM reduced channel plan, careful dispersion management, dynamic gain equalization, and high gain super-FEC.

articleTitle: Full-WDM-band photodiode modules for optical communications at 40 Gb/s and beyond
abstract: This paper presents the first demonstration of the high-speed full-WDM-band photodiode modules for the WDM systems throughout the S (1460-1530 nm) to U (1625-1675 nm) bands with bit-rates up to 40 Gb/s or above.

articleTitle: Specialty fiber: novel fibers for devices
abstract: Fiber-based devices like EDFA and DCMs are critical building blocks of communications systems. In several new areas, novel fibers enable new properties and advances in photonic components. Areas like amplification, dispersion control, nonlinear devices and microstructured fiber will be discussed.

articleTitle: All-optical switching in microring devices by carrier injection
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical switching in laterally coupled GaAs-AlGaAs microring resonators by carrier injection. The microrings are optically pumped just above their bandgap energy, resulting in a tuning of their resonance wavelengths due to the refractive index change.

articleTitle: Highly reliable ridge waveguide 980 nm pump lasers suitable for submarine and metro application
abstract: Very low failure rate acquired from ridge waveguide 980 nm pump lasers with window structure is described using thermal and power dependence of random failure. This laser is suitable for both submarine and uncooled metro application.

articleTitle: Mode-filtering characteristics of hard-polymer cladding fiber
abstract: Bandwidth improvement due to the mode-filtering effect caused by mode-dependent loss mechanism in a hard-polymer cladding fiber was investigated experimentally as well as numerically. We believe this principle can be applied to silica and plastic multimode fibers.

articleTitle: Evaluation on fiber boot of optical component by bend radius measurement in side pull test
abstract: A novel approach is proposed to evaluate the strain relief boot on optical fiber components by measuring the fiber bend radius in side pull test. The criterion and process are provided.

articleTitle: Modified group-velocity dispersion in extruded photonic crystal fiber
abstract: We present measurements of group-velocity dispersion (GVD) in photonic crystal fibers extruded from SF6 glass and intended for nonlinear applications. We report fibers with high nonlinearity and with zero GVD at tele-communications wavelengths.

articleTitle: A novel waveguide structure for polarization insensitive AWGs
abstract: We developed a novel waveguide structure to realize polarization-insensitive AWGs. The waveguides involve a cap layer on top of the cores. Experimental and modeling results show that PDW of AWGs can be minimized (<0.01nm) by adjusting the cap thickness.

articleTitle: Tradeoffs for performance in long-haul transmission systems: a carrier's perspective
abstract: Tradeoffs abound in optical transmission system design, and it's critical for carriers to understand their priorities based on network/service characteristics, and select systems that meet their needs at the lowest first and per-channel cost. There are a number of tradeoffs that can be made in system design, and having a clear view of network topology, traffic requirements and operational needs can help in finding the best system for a particular carrier's network and application. Fiber remains an important driver for system design.

articleTitle: 40 Gbit/s electroabsorption modulator module with driver IC integrated in a single package
abstract: A 0.5 Vpp-drive small-chirp 40 Gbit/s electroabsorption modulator module with hybrid-integrated driver IC is proposed. This module can be directly driven by the 40 Gbit/s multiplexer output. Power penalty of less than 0.5 dB over 2 km transmission is demonstrated.

articleTitle: A high-density optical circuit using downsized fibers and flame-retardant fiber-ribbons for integrated optical module
abstract: We developed a novel high-density and flameproof optical circuit using downsized fibers and new design fiber-ribbons suitable for WDM components. The relationship between failure probability in the tight bending condition and glass-diameter is discussed. Characteristics of key-devices are reported.

articleTitle: Threshold pump power dependence on the spectral alignment between the gain peak and the cavity resonance in InGaAsP photonic crystal lasers
abstract: The dependence of the threshold pump power on wavelength is investigated for a multiwavelength array of photonic crystal lasers. The temperature dependence of these lasers are also characterized. In this study photonic crystal lasers is investigated, while utilizing the ability to lithographically tune the photonic crystal laser cavity resonant frequency so as to investigate the dependence of the threshold pump power on the alignment between the gain peak and the cavity resonance. The effects of operating temperature on the operating wavelength and the threshold pump power are also investigated.

articleTitle: New services for the optical network
abstract: This talk addresses new optical services with dynamic operation to make bandwidth available when needed and better granularity to "right-size" connections, increase efficiency and be more data-friendly. The result is more flexibility with significantly lower capital and operations expenditures.

articleTitle: Parametric amplification for controlling timing jitter in dispersion-managed lightwave systems
abstract: We show that the timing jitter in dispersion-managed lightwave systems can be reduced considerably by replacing erbium-doped fiber amplifiers with the parametric amplifiers in which four-wave mixing is used to generate a phase-conjugated signal.

articleTitle: 40 GHz rational harmonic mode-locking of erbium-doped fiber laser with optical pulse injection
abstract: We demonstrate a 10 ps, 40 GHz repetitive rational harmonic mode-locked optical pulse-train generated from an active mode-locked fiber ring laser by using gain-switched Fabry-Perot laser diode as a gain modulator.

articleTitle: Polarization-insensitive four-wave mixing wavelength conversion using a fiber Bragg grating and a Faraday rotator mirror
abstract: We demonstrate a simple technique for polarization-insensitive four-wave mixing wavelength conversion in dispersion-shifted fibers using a fiber Bragg grating and a Faraday rotator mirror.

articleTitle: 168 Channels/spl times/6 Gb/s (1 Tb/s aggregate) from a multiwavelength modelocked semiconductor laser
abstract: The paper describes a gain-flattened multiwavelength modelocked semiconductor laser that generates 750 Mb/s return-to-zero pulses into 168 discrete wavelength channels. Optical time division multiplexing multiplies the pulse-repetition rate to 6 Gb/s per channel to yield an aggregate pulse rate of 1 Tb/s. Optical fiber deployment in the access network, which bridges the transport network and subscribers, hinges on the availability of cost-effective wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) light sources. Multiwavelength lasers have evolved into realistic candidates to satiate this need owing to their ability to generate a large number of WDM channels from a single source.

articleTitle: Elimination of self-contamination in high-density low-loss single mode fiber array-connectors
abstract: We report quantitative measurements of self-contamination in conventional and modified multiSMF MT connector ferrules. The modifications enable connector wear, insertion loss (IL), and IL reproducibility that are essentially equivalent to conventional ceramic ferrule connectors.

articleTitle: Optical networking standards
abstract: Summary form only given. This tutorial will survey optical networking industry standards, the organizations where they were developed, and the processes and procedure by which those organizations operate.

articleTitle: A 160-GHz semiconductor mode-locked laser directly driven by an 80-GHz electrical signal
abstract: 163.66-GHz optical pulse train was generated by a semiconductor mode-locked laser integrated with a high-mesa EA modulator synchronized with 81.83-GHz electrical signal. Timing jitter of 0.15 ps and very low amplitude modulation noise are achieved.

articleTitle: Electrical estimation of polarization mode dispersion parameters for compensation
abstract: A method to estimate the parameters of polarization mode dispersion (PMD) from the received signal power is developed and used to mitigate pulse distortion due to PMD.

articleTitle: Influence of the model of random birefringence on the PMD of periodically spun fibers
abstract: We show that the differential group delay of randomly birefringent periodically spun fibers, depends strongly on the model used for the birefringence. Overly simple models may overestimate the benefit of spin in reducing polarization mode dispersion.

articleTitle: Real-time OC-192 all-optical bit-error monitoring system using inverted wavelength converter and optical NOR gate
abstract: A low cost, simple bit-error monitoring system is realized all-optically using an inverted wavelength-converter and optical NOR-gate with different operating thresholds. Real-time optical monitoring signal is generated which indicates the positions and duration of bit/burst errors in 10 Gb/s signal.

articleTitle: Polarization mode dispersion, decorrelation, and diffusion in optical fibers with randomly varying elliptical birefringence
abstract: In this paper, dependence of both the polarization decorrelation length and the diffusion length on the amount of ellipticity present in an optical fiber was described. A small elliptical birefringence in optical fibers yields the same differential group delay as in linearly birefringent fiber. However, ellipticity may affect the interaction of nonlinearity and polarization mode dispersion during propagation.

articleTitle: Merits of low-density WDM line systems for long-haul networks
abstract: We show that 20-wavelength WDM links can cost 64%-79% of the cost of 80-wavelength links and still be competitive due to future cost reductions, nonuniform network capacities and span maintenance support. We reason why this cost reduction is feasible.

articleTitle: Cyclic and rectangular passband optical SSB filter using AWG pair
abstract: We demonstrate a novel optical band-pass filter consisting of an arrayed-waveguide grating pair. The filter has a flat passband of 40 GHz, a sharp rolloff and a periodicity of 200 GHz, which makes it useful for WDM single sideband filtering.

articleTitle: Tunable optoelectronic bandpass filter using simple self-pulsating two-section laser
abstract: We demonstrate tunable optoelectronic bandpass filtering of an ASK modulated subcarrier data stream, using a two-section laser. Optical gain is measured when the laser is locked to a .697 GHz and 1.1 GHz carrier frequency.

articleTitle: Dispersion compensation with an SBS-suppressed fiber phase conjugator using synchronized phase modulation
abstract: About 204 km, 10 Gb/s standard optical fiber transmission is successfully demonstrated using mid-span spectral inversion (MSSI) technique with a SBS-suppressed fiber phase conjugator, which we proposed recently. Transmission performance has been improved compared with a conventional phase conjugator.

articleTitle: Demonstration of all-optical packet demultiplexing using a multiwavelength mutual injection-locked laser diode
abstract: All-optical packet demultiplexing is demonstrated using a multiwavelength mutual injection-locked Fabry-Perot laser diode. Error-free packet-demultiplexing of a 10 Gb/s signal with an extinction ratio of 16.9 dB is observed.

articleTitle: Vertical-cavity saturable absorber intensity modulator
abstract: We demonstrate a vertical-cavity intensity modulator exploiting optical pumping of a semiconductor saturable absorber mirror. The device reflection is modulated by means of a control beam generated by a laser integrated within the modulator structure.

articleTitle: An optical pump controlled tunable phase-shifted fiber grating transmission filter
abstract: We demonstrate a phase-shifted fiber grating transmission filter remotely tunable using optical pump-induced thermal effects in Er/Yb codoped fiber sections. A wavelength-independent induced phase shift of 0.1 /spl pi//mW and a transmission extinction ratio of > 21dB are achieved.

articleTitle: Polarization insensitive waveform restoration and channel crosstalk reduction in semiconductor optical amplifier gates using polarimetric filtering
abstract: We present a polarization-insensitive approach for waveform restoration in semiconductor-optical-amplifier (SOA) based optical gates using nonlinear polarization rotation in SOA and polarimetric filtering. The scheme is capable of suppressing the channel crosstalk owing to SOA's cross-gain-modulation for multiple input wavelengths.

articleTitle: A bandwidth-efficient and low-latency packet assembly strategy for optical burst switching in metro ring
abstract: A multiflow assembly strategy is presented that creates data bursts, transmitted all-optically over the WDM LightRing. Both high bandwidth-efficiency and low packet-latency are obtained by uniquely combining spatial reuse and assembly of multiflow packets.

articleTitle: Ultra-high capacity submarine transmission
abstract: Recent works on high capacity submarine transmission lead to industrial terabit systems. Highest capacity requirements can be addressed by an appropriate choice between emerging technologies already under laboratory investigations.

articleTitle: Spectral shape tunable band-rejection filter using long period fiber gratings with divided coil heater
abstract: We developed a new type of tunable band rejection filter which provides high spectral shaping flexibility in a wide tuning range. This filter was consisted of a LPFG and a divided coil heaters.

articleTitle: Novel arrayed waveguide grating designs fo optical monitoring
abstract: New concepts of AWG-based optical monitoring are proposed. One design utilizes currently unused diffraction orders to derive channel information. The other focuses signals to photodiode for spectrum monitoring. Some proof of principle experimental results will be presented at the meeting.

articleTitle: Photosensitivity and photosensitization of highly phosphorus-doped fibers under 157-nm F/sub 2/ excimer laser irradiation
abstract: Photosensitivity of highly phosphorus-doped fibers under 157-nm F/sub 2/ excimer laser irradiation has been investigated for the first time, Photosensitivity as well as photosensitization effects have been found to be much stronger as compared to 193-nm irradiation.

articleTitle: Selectively buried ion-exchanged waveguides as an interface to electro-optic polymers
abstract: The fabrication of selectively buried ion-exchanged waveguides in glass is described. The results presented demonstrate that surface sections of the waveguides interact strongly with an electro-optic polymer superstrate.

articleTitle: Slot synchronization in wavelength-routed star networks based on broadcasting frames from a multifrequency laser
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a synchronization technique for wavelength-routed star networks. A multifrequency tunable laser in a master node performs broadcasting function to synchronize the network nodes.

articleTitle: Fusion bonded transmission gratings for temperature compensated DWDM de-multiplexing
abstract: Wafer fusion bonding of fused silica, surface relief transmission gratings have been demonstrated. Used in DWDM free-space devices, the bonded gratings have an athermal behaviour, a large mechanical ruggedness and in some cases higher diffraction efficiencies than nonbonded gratings.

articleTitle: Long wavelength surface emitting lasers in 1.2-1.3 /spl mu/m wavelength band
abstract: We present the fabrication and lasing characteristics of 1.2-1.3 /spl mu/m band GaInAs/GaAs and GaInNAs/GaAs VCSELs. Excellent temperature characteristics enable uncooled operations of long wavelength VCSELs. Also, multiple-wavelength VCSEL arrays are demonstrated for high capacity networks.

articleTitle: Spectral efficiency of coded phase modulation for high-speed fiber optic communication
abstract: The spectral efficiencies of optical modulation and detection schemes are computed using information-theoretic techniques. The results quantify by how much phase-shift-keying can outperform direct-detection on-off keying when these modulations are used in conjunction with forward error control.

articleTitle: FASTeR: shared restoration without signalling
abstract: We present a novel technique for rapid restoration in optical/electrical mesh networks that does not incur signaling or cross-connect setup latencies. We show that it easily meets the 50 ms requirement in most scenarios.

articleTitle: Feature and performance enhancements of dynamic optical networks
abstract: Carriers' requirements for flexible, programmable, yet cost-effective optical transport networks is discussed in the context of emerging components and sub-systems as well as the resultant performance improvements they offer the optical transport layer.

articleTitle: Birefringence in benzocyclobutene strip optical waveguides
abstract: This paper presents the fabrication of benzocyclobutene strip optical waveguides and the measurement of their birefringence properties. The experimental results are shown to agree with the theoretical calculation. The condition for obtaining zero birefringence is highlighted. These waveguides are potentially useful for the construction of polarization-insensitive polymer-based optical devices.

articleTitle: Single fiber bidirectional self-healing ring by sharing amplifier and DCF
abstract: We demonstrate single fiber bidirectional self-healing ring network by using B-OADM sharing EDFA and DCF. Proposed ring network is possible to detect fiber cut and isn't affected by optical back-reflection in case of transmission failure.

articleTitle: Measuring component DGD by using polarized ASE noise and monitoring the degree of polarization
abstract: We demonstrate a novel technique for measuring the first and second order PMD of in-line components and PMD emulators by scrambling a narrow band ASE noise source. We show that the PMD is related to the minimum and maximum DOP.

articleTitle: Cost-saving opportunity for the MAN - DCM and amplifier placement for metro optical networks
abstract: The distinct challenges of determining the placement of DCMs and amplifiers in metro-area networks are reviewed. Several algorithms leading to near-optimum placements are proposed and their effectiveness are analyzed and compared.

articleTitle: Measurement of multipath interference in the coherent cross-talk regime
abstract: We compare various techniques to measure MPI in devices exhibiting distributed coherent crosstalk. Such devices are susceptible to deterministic noise as well as intermittent fading, and the measurement technique employed must capture both these manifestations of MPI. We evaluate several measurement techniques used to characterise MPI in few mode fibers. The coherent, distributed nature of MPI in few-mode fibers leads to fast fluctuations, manifesting in deterministic noise, as well as slow variations, reminiscent of fading in mobile communications systems. Slow temporal intensity variations of a CW DFB laser captures most of the relevant information.

articleTitle: Absorption controlled photo-imageable silanes for integrated optics
abstract: Novel fluorinated hybrid sol-gel materials are developed which show internal losses <0.1dB/cm. Compact beam splitters are demonstrated exhibiting propagation losses <0.5 dB/cm, power uniformity <1 dB and coupling losses <1.5 dB for commercialization of the sol-gel amplifying splitters.

articleTitle: In-situ etched buried heterostructures for uncooled and extended reach modulated lasers
abstract: We report on in-situ etched and regrown buried heterostructure devices. Excellent surface morphology and reduction in surface damage lead to a 20% decrease in threshold current and 50% reduced burn-in degradation rates compared with standard processed devices.

articleTitle: BER and total throughput of asynchronous DS-OCDMA/WDM systems with multiple user interference
abstract: The BER and throughput of direct-sequence OCDMA/WDM systems based on quadripolar codes and superstructured fiber Bragg gratings are statistically derived under asynchronous operation, intensity detection, and multiple user interference. Performance improvements with forward error correction are included.

articleTitle: Architecture of 1024/spl times/1024 three-dimensional micro optical switching systems with self-organized lightwave network
abstract: A three-dimensional micro optical switching system consisting of self-organized lightwave network and stacked films with embedded micro optical switches is assessed to realize 1024/spl times/1024 switching at 10/sup 5/-1/s rate with /spl sim/1.4/spl times/0.6-cm/sup 2/ size and 32-dB insertion loss.

articleTitle: Dynamically provisioned optical network enabled by pump-power control of distributed Raman amplification
abstract: Pump-power control of distributed Raman amplification enables dynamic provisioning, while offers a safety function against optical hazards. We use the difference in receiver sensitivity between control signal (10 Mbit/s-class) and data (10 Gbit/s-class) to realize dynamic provisioning.

articleTitle: 1 THz-step bandwidth upgrades in broadband Raman amplifier by adding pump laser diodes
abstract: A bandwidth-upgradeable Raman amplifier by adding laser diodes at different wavelengths was developed. We show that the total cumulative pump power can be decreased to one half for the bandwidth extension toward shorter wavelength as compared with the opposite case.

articleTitle: Predefined path selection methods for dynamic routing and wavelength assignment in WDM networks
