abstract: We present new predefined path selection methods for dynamic routing and wavelength assignment (RWA) in wavelength-routed WDM networks. Toward the goal of optimizing the performance, we formulate the predefined path selection problems as integer linear programming (ILP) problems.

articleTitle: Impact of traffic topology on wavelength demand in wavelength routed optical networks
abstract: We present heuristic formulas derived from simulations to estimate the wavelength demand in photonic networks. Simple and general formulas may help carriers and technical sales to reduce network planning costs.

articleTitle: Picosecond pulse-generating laser with repetition rate of 10 GHz and rms timing jitter <100 fs fully tunable over C-band
abstract: We demonstrate wavelength tuning over the whole C-band of a compact, passively fundamental-mode-locked, Er:Yb:glass laser producing high-contrast-ratio picosecond pulses at a repetition rate of 10 GHz and average power exceeding 10 mW.

articleTitle: Segmented 1.55 /spl mu/m laser with 400% differential quantum efficiency
abstract: By electrically segmenting, and series-connecting an InP ridge laser, we have demonstrated 12-stage lasers with 409 % differential efficiency and 2.6 mA threshold, as well as 3-stage lasers with 51 ohm input impedance and 126 % differential efficiency.

articleTitle: Fiber fuse effect in microstructured fibers
abstract: In this paper we report the first observation of the fuse effect in a microstructured fiber. The fiber was fabricated by drilling holes in a silica rod and subsequent drawing of a fiber with output diameter of 125 /spl mu/m. The threshold intensity of laser radiation and some features of catastrophic damage differ strongly from those for conventional silica-based fibers.

articleTitle: Tapered index-coupled 1.55/spl mu/m InGaAsP/InP-BH-DFB-laser with chirped-period gratings
abstract: All-active tapered index coupled 1.55 /spl mu/m InGaAsP-BH-DFB-lasers involving chirped gratings were realized for the first time. The laser show small far-fields, high output power and high single mode yield.

articleTitle: Amplified coarse WDM system employing uncooled fiber Bragg grating lasers with 600 GHz channel spacing
abstract: We propose a cost-effective 8-channel coarse WDM system employing uncooled fiber Bragg grating lasers with 600 GHz channel spacing. Gigabit Ethernet transmission experiment using a conventional EDFA supports feasibility of this system even over dispersion-shifted fibers.

articleTitle: Critical issues in the modeling of WDM systems in the linear and nonlinear regimes
abstract: We describe the critical aspects of WDM systems that must be considered in order to accurately model signal propagation in the linear and nonlinear regimes. We experimentally validate the results of numerical simulation. The use of modeling tools has proven to be a crucial and efficient way of determining the performance of optical communication systems. Rigorous experimental validation is essential in order to identify the critical aspects of these systems and incorporate them into the modeling tools to ensure accurate results.

articleTitle: Polymer compositions for broadband thermooptically controlled safety shutters, switches, neutral density filters, and attenuators
abstract: Compositions are described with low ON-state insertion loss (<0.1 dB/cm). Their sharp thermooptic transition (>5 dB/cm//spl deg/C) enables design of compact, high extinction ratio (>20 dB/cm) shutters, switches, variable neutral density filters, and variable optical attenuators.

articleTitle: Exact ab-initio modeling of arrayed-waveguide gratings
abstract: For the first time a complete ab-initio calculation of AWG's including coupling and defocus is presented. The full paraxial approximation together with an ortho-normal basis (ONB) expansion of the modes and a unitary approximation of the transfer matrix is used.

articleTitle: Cable repairs with dispersion managed fibers and block scheme for chromatic dispersion compensation
abstract: Cable repair management is investigated using D/sub +//D/sub -/ fibers and block chromatic dispersion scheme. It is demonstrated that repairing the cable is possible without damaging the transmission performance and using simple in line cable management.

articleTitle: Core mesh optical networks: a European carrier's perspective
abstract: Summary form only given. Experiences with mesh restoration in a former SDH network are presented. Results of mesh core networks design studies are given with respect to opaque and transparent scenarios and problems of inter-working of mesh restoration domains are discussed.

articleTitle: Data over transport: the generic framing procedure
abstract: Next generation optical transport networks require a light-weight traffic adaptation mechanism to multiplex low-rating electrical signals into large capacity optical channel The mechanism must be flexible, low complexity and able to support a variety of data signals operating at rates from 10 Mbps to 10 Gbps and beyond. The Generic Framing Procedure (GFP) is an ITU-T/ANSI standard specially designed to fulfill this role. This document provides an overrview of the problem, the procedures and the target applications.

articleTitle: Dynamic MEMS
abstract: Dynamic MEMS devices offer a variety of potential solutions for management of DWDM networks. This paper examines such issues as degrees of freedom of motion, speed, and sensitivity to shock and vibration, with examples.

articleTitle: A small (37 cc) one-fiber WDM optical Ethernet PC card for fiber-to-the-notebook-PC
abstract: A very slim and small interface card for fiber-to-the-desktop has been developed. It has a simplex MU receptacle, and a one-fiber WDM Ethernet interface using PLC hybrid module, and is suitable for notebook PCs.

articleTitle: The method for manufacturing graded-index polymer rod
abstract: A useful method to prepare the polymer rods to be used for the preform to make the graded index polymer optical fiber (GI-POF) or for the optical rod lens is proposed. It is concluded that the polymer rod is prepared successfully by utilizing the swelling of the polymers and the diffusion of the monomers in the polymer-monomer mixtures. The diameter of the GI-POF will be controlled to 1.0mm(core 0.98mm and clad 0.02mm) in the experiment.

articleTitle: Effect of mode cut-off on dispersion in photonic bandgap fibers
abstract: The phase dispersion of the fundamental mode in two different photonic bandgap fibers is measured and compared. The difference in dispersion behavior is attributed to the location of the mode cut-off relative to the bandgap.

articleTitle: Raman-pumped, dense dispersion-managed soliton transmission of 80 Gb/s OTDM data
abstract: The effects of radiation from dense dispersion-managed solitons into the normal-dispersion portion of their optical spectrum are observed for the first time in a novel Raman-pumped data transmission system. Filtering allows error-free propagation of 80-Gb/s OTDM data over 963 km.

articleTitle: A 43-Gbit/s clock and data recovery OEIC using InP/lnGaAs HPT/HBTs
abstract: A new clock and data recovery OEIC where 43-Gbit/s data is regenerated with the recovered 43-GHz clock by the HPT optical injection-locked oscillator achieves error-free operation for 2/sup 31/-1 PRBS with extremely low power consumption of 0.79 W.

articleTitle: Integration of fiber optic lenses with small form factor MEMS components
abstract: Passively alignable lensed fiber was designed to enable significantly reduced component assembly costs with optical MEMS devices. Passive alignment with <0.5 dB loss/pair was demonstrated. Integration of lensed fiber with small form factor MEMS switch on silicon chip was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Transient effects in low-noise dispersion-compensating hybrid fiber amplifier
abstract: Transient effects in low-noise dispersion-compensating hybrid fiber amplifier (DC-HFA) are presented to show the combined dynamics of EDFA and Raman amplifier. A gain control method is demonstrated in DC-HFA by numerical simulation, and the advantages of the method are discussed.

articleTitle: Nonlinear multiplexing in optical fiber communications
abstract: The nonlinear evolution of a dispersion-managed soliton admits a novel nonlinear multiplexing scheme for optical communications. Information is coded onto the canonical parameters (chirp and width) characterizing the pulse. It is shown that in dispersion-managed fiber communication channels, there exists the possibility of a nonlinear multiplexing scheme, with no linear analog, that effectively multiplies the bit-rate throughput several-fold. Alternatively, the same bit-rate is achieved while relaxing the requirements on the pulse width, so that slower modulation speeds and narrowband in-line filters may be used without paying a penalty in the information-transfer rate. In addition, the scheme is insensitive to minor variations in the multiplexing parameters. The analysis is based on a Hamiltonian reduction of the dispersion-managed nonlinear Schrodinger equation, and is corroborated with direct numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Raman induced cross talk with PRBS modulation
abstract: Stimulated Raman scattering between correlated PRBS modulated channels in experimental WDM systems causes cross-talk penalties. Various de-correlation techniques do not suppress this effect. We report on experimental observation of penalties up to 3 dB and find an optimum de-correlation technique.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of a fiber-based optical 2R regenerator in front of an 80Gbit/s receiver
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time to our knowledge, an 80 Gbit/s optical 2R regenerator based on self phase modulation in fiber. The potential improvement in receiver sensitivity and tolerance to degraded optical signal-to-noise ratio is investigated.

articleTitle: Validation of a simple, tunable-chirp 40-Gb/s RZ pulse carver using fulloptical field characterization
abstract: A simple, single-modulator solution for generating return-to-zero pulses with adjustable chirp and duty cycles between 33% and 67% is studied. The temporal phase and intensity of the pulses are measured at 40 Gbit/s using the spectrogram method.

articleTitle: Chromatic-dispersion-insensitive PMD monitoring using optical off-center bandpass filtering
abstract: We demonstrate that by using an off-center optical bandpass filter and monitoring the extracted clock power, an accurate PMD feedback signal is realized. This feedback signal is insensitive to chromatic dispersion.

articleTitle: A novel technique to overcome the polarization effects
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel technique to overcome the deleterious polarization effects such as PMD, PDG and PDL simultaneously. The results show that this technique could prevent both the PMD-induced power penalty and repolarization.

articleTitle: A novel method for optical subcarrier label generation
abstract: We propose a novel architecture for an optical subcarrier label transmitter. An optical signal consisting of a 10 Gb/s payload and a 156 Mb/s label was generated, and its performance was evaluated in a transmission link.

articleTitle: Dynamic adaptation of a PLC residual chromatic dispersion compensator at 40Gb/s
abstract: Continuous and error-burst free adaptation of a PLC based MZI-lattice filter to a changing dispersion was experimentally demonstrated at 40 Gb/s using an eye monitor as feedback signal. Tapping of optical power enabled separate wavelength locking.

articleTitle: Numerical study of dispersion tolerance of 43 Gbit/s SOA-MZI based optical 3R regenerators in long-haul transmission lines
abstract: The dispersion tolerance of SOA-MZI-based optical 3R regenerators implemented in a 2400km-long 40 Gbit/s WDM transmission line is numerically investigated, showing a wide +/-20 ps/nm range in the dispersion compensation when considering a 5 dB reduction in the system performance.

articleTitle: Identification of sources of degradation in optical channels using deconvolution technique
abstract: A novel histogram method to estimate the white Gaussian noise in the network is proposed. This method can be used to correctly deconvolve white noise from other sources of degradation. The limits of the deconvolution technique are also investigated.

articleTitle: Theory, simulation, and measurements for new model of spectral hole burning in EDFA
abstract: A new model of spectral hole burning effect in EDFA is suggested. Experiments were conducted to identify the hole burning mechanism. The shape and the depth of the spectral hole are in accordance with the suggested approach.

articleTitle: Simultaneous 2R regeneration and dynamic dispersion compensation at 40 Gb/s in a nonlinear fiber-based device
abstract: Simultaneous dynamic dispersion compensation (130 ps/nm range) and 2R regeneration (2 dB receiver sensitivity improvement) are demonstrated for a 40 Gb/s CS-RZ signal using soliton effect pulse compression and narrowband spectral filtering.

articleTitle: Electronically synthesized polarization mode coupling interactions in LiNbO/sub 3/ integrated optical devices
abstract: A widely tunable electro-optically controlled filter in LiNbO/sub 3/ has been created. The limited tunability of LiNbO/sub 3/ electro-optic devices has been overcome via a novel interdigitated electrode structure driven by mixed signal CMOS ASICs.

articleTitle: Novel design method for generalized lattice filters
abstract: A new design method for wide-band gain equalizers using cascaded MZI's is proposed. The method achieves a given accuracy with fewer stages than previously described methods. Furthermore, the method is capable of minimizing PDL.

articleTitle: A high coherence supercontinuum source at 1550 nm
abstract: We present a low noise supercontinuum source based on a femtosecond fiber laser. Varying the dispersion along the fiber length generates a flat, symmetrically broadened continuum. No degradation in coherence is observed.

articleTitle: Economic considerations of central office (CO) broadband distribution terminals vs. remote terminal (RT) broadband distribution terminals for deploying fiber to the home (FTTH)
abstract: This paper presents the results of a study examining the economics of central office versus remote terminal broadband distribution terminals for deploying fiber to the home. The effects of integrating DSL for copper distribution areas with FTTH is also examined.

articleTitle: Nonlinear tolerant and spectrally efficient 86 Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK format for a system upgrade
abstract: We propose a method employing 86 Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK format to enable doubling the capacity of 43 Gbit/s WDM systems. Its relaxed OSNR, chromatic dispersion and PMD requirements allow the upgrade without changing WDM optics, using 43 Gbit/s electronics.

articleTitle: Applications of electroabsorption modulators in high bit-rate extended reach transmission systems
abstract: We report the demonstration of 1310 nm and 1550 nm electroabsorption modulators as high output power, low dispersion penalty transmitters in unrepeatered, uncompensated 80-104 km 10 Gbit/s and 2.4-40 km 40 Gbit/s SMF-28 fibre links.

articleTitle: A novel bidirectional optical add-drop multiplexer with gain incorporating a single unidirectional amplifier
abstract: We present a novel bidirectional optical add-drop multiplexer with gain. The device incorporates a single unidirectional amplifier and can flexibly accommodate asymmetric traffic. The device has low crosstalk and removes backscattered light and amplifier noise.

articleTitle: A coaxial DFB laser-diode module with a differential feed for 10-Gb/s Ethernet applications
abstract: A TO-"can"-sized coaxial 10-Gb/s 1.3-/spl mu/m DFB laser-diode module with 28% mask margin at 85/spl deg/C was demonstrated. A differential feed provides ease of installation by low return loss (<-7 dB at 10 GHz, lead length 5 mm).

articleTitle: Compact all-optical parity calculator based on a single all-active Mach Zehnder interferometer with all-SOA amplified feedback
abstract: An all-optical signal processing circuit capable of parity calculations is demonstrated using a single integrated all-active SOA-based MZI, exploiting the integrated SOAs for feedback amplification.

articleTitle: Very short Er-doped silica glass fiber for L-band amplifiers
abstract: We measured 44 dB gain using 12 m of highly Er-doped L-band silica fiber and 235 mW total pump power. Also QCE of 45% and NF <3.5 dB were demonstrated. The 3 dB bandwidth was 40 nm and average PMD was 1.5 fs/m.

articleTitle: Optical damage in fiber optic components
abstract: The introduction of Raman amplifiers and 100/sup +/ channel DWDM systems has enormously increased the optical power handling requirements of fiber optic components. This paper reviews optical power damage and observed failure modes for components such as couplers, switches, and polarization components.

articleTitle: Pre-deployment of OEOs in agile photonic networks
abstract: We show that the main capital cost for remote configurability in optical networks lies in how OEO resources must be pre-deployed in preparation for the next connection request. Photonic switches reduce this cost significantly compared to electrical switches.

articleTitle: Black box model for thulium doped fiber amplifiers
abstract: We present and experimentally validate a black box model for TDFAs. The gain at any wavelength is predicted from measurements of three spectral functions and the gain at two reference wavelengths.

articleTitle: A WDM fiber-radio system with improved optical spectral efficiency incorporating remote LO delivery and novel FBG optical filtering
abstract: A novel WDM fiber radio system with improved spectral efficiency, incorporating remote LO delivery and novel FBG optical filtering techniques is demonstrated. All channels within a 25 GHz band are successfully recovered with minimal degradation.

articleTitle: Transmission in the L/sup +/ band for metropolitan applications
abstract: We demonstrate 10 Gb/s transmission in the 1620-1650 nm band on a metropolitan scaled distance using only Raman amplification. Transmission in the L/sup +/-band should prove useful to expand spectral bandwidth for coarse WDM applications.

articleTitle: RIN transfer suppression technique for 2nd order Raman pumping schemes
abstract: RIN transfer suppression in 2nd order co-propagating pumping schemes is demonstrated. Suppression is achieved by intensity-modulating the seed laser. This technique may enable the use of Raman fiber lasers in co-pumping architectures. An optical technique is demonstrated for suppressing the RIN transfer from a high power lower order pump to the signal radiation in a co-propagating 2nd order pumping configuration. RIN suppression is accomplished by intensity-modulating the intermediate wavelength seed semiconductor laser diode.

articleTitle: Concatenation of interleaved binary/nonbinary block codes for improved forward error correction
abstract: We propose advanced FEC (Forward Error Correction) codeword configurations and decoding strategies that are suitable for next-generation optical communication systems. They consist of the concatenation of a BCH-like binary code and an interleaved nonbinary code with iterative hard-decision decoding. The BER (Bit Error Rate) analysis results as low as 10/sub -15/ show that the proposed scheme outperforms the existing FEC schemes based on product codes. Our super-FEC scheme can be added to the existing ITU-FEC systems at low cost without much extra circuitry or much extra power consumption.

articleTitle: Multifunctional photonic integrated circuits based on SOA and ring resonators
abstract: The broad spectrum of functionalities of SOA integrated PICs including also nonlinearities will produce a new generation of components for optical communication. A snap-shot on different in-line, interferometer, and ring approaches is given.

articleTitle: Optimizing the wavelength configuration for FWM-based demultiplexing in a SOA
abstract: In this paper efficient FWM demultiplexing in a SOA using a well chosen wavelength configuration is presented. A 160-Gbit/s OTDM signal is demultiplexed error-free to a base rate as high as 40 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: High power Raman pumps based on ridge waveguide InGaAsP/InP diode lasers
abstract: This paper presents data on 14xx nm ridge waveguide InGaAsP/InP pump lasers with record powers and efficiency as well as results obtained using these lasers in both fiber-optic modules and Raman pump blocks.

articleTitle: 43-Gbit/s/spl times/40 ch transmission over 1,600 km of conventional single-mode fiber in NRZ modulation scheme
abstract: We demonstrate the feasibility of economical 40-Gbit/s WDM transmission over 1,600-km conventional single-mode fiber with simple NRZ modulation scheme employing two-stage dispersion compensating fiber Raman amplification and optimised dispersion map with excessive in-line dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Noise dependence of high bit-rate optical chaotic communication back-to-back systems
abstract: A comparative study of three data encoding techniques in optical chaotic communication systems is presented, for different RIN levels and bit-rates. High noise level deteriorates the decoded message quality, while after filtering its effect is minimized.

articleTitle: Reduction of chirped fiber grating group delay ripple penalty through UV post processing
abstract: We demonstrate adiabatic UV correction of smoothed group delay ripple from /spl plusmn/10 ps to /spl plusmn/2 ps yielding reduction of OSNR penalty (40Gbit/s CSRZ) from /spl sim/ 4 dB to 0.5 dB over the tunable dispersion range of 270 to 750 ps/nm.

articleTitle: Bend loss in reduced cladding optical fibers
abstract: Reduced cladding fibers (80 /spl mu/m vs. 125 /spl mu/m) are attractive for small form factor components. Experimental and modeling data are presented to show that fiber and/or coil needs redesigning when reducing cladding diameter because of bend loss effects.

articleTitle: Properties of nonlinear photonic crystal fibers for telecommunication applications
abstract: We report on a range of novel properties of the new generation of highly nonlinear photonic crystal fibers with zero dispersion near 1.55 /spl mu/m. Aspects of loss mechanisms, dispersion properties and birefringence tailoring are described.

articleTitle: Wavelength stabilized 980 nm pump laser suitable for uncooled application in metro networks
abstract: Wavelength of 980nm pump lasers are stabilized not only with fiber-Bragg-grating but also without it over wide range of temperature. These are suitable for uncooled fiber amplifier application in metro networks.

articleTitle: Noise reduction capabilities of a Raman-mediated wavelength converter
abstract: We describe ultra wide band, Raman-mediated wavelength conversion. Data conversion from long to short wavelength bands with significant noise reduction are demonstrated experimentally at 10 Gbit/s and confirmed by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Simultaneous multichannel pulse compression for broadband dynamic dispersion compensation
abstract: A novel scheme for multichannel dynamic dispersion compensation in an all-fiber device is proposed. Measurements on simultaneous pulse compression at 10 Gb/s with up to 8 channel show no significant crosstalk penalties and demonstrate the feasibility of the concept.

articleTitle: Highly efficient lens-less coupling of high-speed waveguide photodiode to SMF and its application to an extremely thin surface-mountable 10-Gbps receiver module
abstract: We demonstrate a high-speed waveguide photo-diode that has high responsivity when butt-coupled to a flat-ended single-mode fiber. An extremely thin lens-less surface-mountable 10-Gbps receiver module with this photodiode installed has a high responsivity (0.97 A/W) and high sensitivity (-18.8 dBm).

articleTitle: Long-term reliability of high performance waveguide integrated photodetectors for 40 Gb/s applications and beyond
abstract: Waveguide integrated photodetectors for 40 Gb/s are promising candidates to serve an increasing demand for advanced components in telecommunications and measurement equipment. An overview on long-term reliability of those devices is given for chips and modules.

articleTitle: Performance comparison of all-optical signal regenerators utilizing self-phase modulation in fibers
abstract: 3R regeneration capabilities of two types of fiber-based signal regenerators are numerically compared. The regenerator based on spectrum broadening in normal-dispersion fiber has better 2R but worse retiming capabilities than the regenerator based on soliton compression in anomalous-dispersion fiber.

articleTitle: Optical power monitoring function compatible with single chip integration on silicon-on-insulator
abstract: A novel monolithic p-i-n waveguide photodiode technology based on implantation into the silicon-on-insulator materials system is outlined. This technology enables multichannel average power monitoring to be integrated on a single chip together with multiplexer and attenuator functions.

articleTitle: Comparison of linear fiber impairments tolerance among 40 Gb/s modulation formats
abstract: We experimentally compare the robustness of 40Gb/s NRZ, NRZ-VSB, CSRZ, BL-CSRZ, RZ, and RZ-VSB formats in the presence of combined residual CD and 1st order PMD. The result shows that RZ-VSB has the best tolerance without adaptive CD/PMD compensation.

articleTitle: High gain 40 Gb/s InP HBT drivers for EO/EA modulators
abstract: Single chip high gain InP HBT modulator drivers for 40 Gb/S systems are presented. With 30 dB gain, 41 GHz bandwidth and 6Vp-p differential output, the need for external pre-amplifiers and bias networks are eliminated. Transmitter performance with EO/EA modulators are evaluated.

articleTitle: Tunable semiconductor lasers
abstract: Summary form only be given. Tunable semiconductor lasers continue to be included in just about everyone's list of important components for future fiber optic networks. Various designs will be overviewed with particular emphasis on the widely tunable (>32 nm) types.

articleTitle: Prototype demonstration of on-demand/scheduled wavelength path service
abstract: This paper describes a newly developed on-demand/scheduled wavelength path service prototype and a practical approach for the realization of new services enabled by generalized multiprotocol label switching in conjunction with security and operation support system.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum generation in a highly nonlinear fiber using a continuous wave pump
abstract: Supercontinuum generation with a bandwidth greater than 247 nm is demonstrated in a highly nonlinear fiber by pumping with a continuous wave Raman fiber laser in the anomalous dispersion regime. The continuum showed good long-term power stability.

articleTitle: Interleaver-based method for full utilization of the bandwidth of fiber optical parametric amplifiers and wavelength converters
abstract: We present a method using two parallel fiber optical parametric amplifiers (OPAs) and two interleavers, which allow one to either amplify or spectrally invert a broad spectrum. This permits the utilization of the full bandwidth of OPAs and wavelength converters.

articleTitle: Reliability of widely-tunable SGDBR lasers suitable for deployment in agile networks
abstract: We present reliability data on widely tunable diode lasers with sampled grating Bragg mirrors. The lasers have a median life over two hundred years with a wear-out failure rate below 200 failures per billion device-hours.

articleTitle: Suppression of optical harmonics in wavelength conversion using optical single-sideband modulator
abstract: For wavelength conversion using an optical SSB modulator, we proposed a novel technique for suppression of undesired harmonics, which gives the conventional theoretical limit of SNR, by feeding the fundamental and 3rd order harmonic rf-signals.

articleTitle: A swept-wavelength Raman pump with 69 MHz repetition rate
abstract: We demonstrate a novel, high repetition rate, swept-wavelength Raman pump source. The pump has a FWHM of 31 nm, average power of 350 mW, and sweep repetition rate of 69 MHz.

articleTitle: Wavelength-selectable DBR laser array inherently free from mode-hopping for high-speed switching
abstract: We demonstrated inherently mode-hop-free wavelength tuning of 4.45 nm in a DBR laser with a short active-region. Dynamic characteristics on error-free operation and fast switching are confirmed. A wavelength-selectable laser array integrated with DBR lasers achieved tuning of 12.45 nm.

articleTitle: EAM with improved switching performance by self cascading
abstract: The self cascading of an electroabsorption modulator (EAM) with commercially available components improves the switching performance of a single electroabsorption modulator. The improved performance is demonstrated in 160 to 40 Gbit/s demultiplexing experiments and 40 GHz pulse generation.

articleTitle: Tunable second order dispersion compensator using fiber Bragg grating with double ring structure
abstract: Tunable second order dispersion compensator is realized utilizing linear chirped FBG with double ring structure. Tunable range from -100 to 100 ps/nm/sup 2/ is achieved in keeping center wavelength and first order dispersion constant.

articleTitle: Optimization for CD characteristic of Band-OADM using 4-skip-0 100GHz filter
abstract: We optimized designing and manufacturing of 4-skip-0 100GHz filter, and also the configuration of module with regards to Band-OADM for metro networks. It enables to manufacture the OADMs that exhibit better transmission performance of add/drop functionalities.

articleTitle: Proactive contention avoidance in OBS networks
abstract: We propose to use BORA (burst overlap reduction algorithm) to schedule locally assembled bursts so as to proactively avoid burst contention at downstream nodes in optical burst switched (OBS) networks.

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated 32-channel client re-configurable optical add/drop multiplexer on planar lightwave circuit
abstract: A monolithically integrated 32-channel client re-configurable optical add/drop multiplexer on silica-based planar lightwave circuit is demonstrated. It can be reconfigured to add/drop any of the 32 input channels from/to any of the 4 add/ drop ports.

articleTitle: Large-area single-mode photonic bandgap VCSELs
abstract: We demonstrate that the photonic bandgap effect can be used to control the modes of large area vertical cavity surface emitting lasers. We obtain more than 20 dB side mode suppression ratios in a 10-micron area device.

articleTitle: An all-optical bufferless multiwavelength sorter for 40 Gb/s asynchronous variable-length optical packets
abstract: We present a new all-optical multiwavelength sorter designed for asynchronous, variable-length packets. We demonstrate experimentally that the scheme efficiently implements sorting function without contention for 40 Gb/s variable packets at a BER of less than 10/sup -9/ without an error floor.

articleTitle: Low pump power, short-fiber dual-pumped (800 nm+1050 nm) TDFA
abstract: A 5-m long 2000-ppm Tm-doped fiber pumped with 145-mW total at 800 nm+1050 nm wavelengths produced 18-dB gain. Optical frequency domain reflectometry revealed the gain distribution and permitted optimizing the system.

articleTitle: Polymer waveguides and device applications
abstract: We have developed highly robust polymers derived from liquid multifunctional acrylate monomers that produce waveguides that offer propagation losses equivalent to planar silica guides. This materials technology enables a variety of high performance thermo-optic devices.

articleTitle: Multitributary OFDM optical transmitter using carrier-suppressed optical single-sideband modulation
abstract: A multitributary optical transmitter is reported using carrier-suppressed OSSB modulation. A number of OFDM-channels can be generated by a single optical modulator. Duobinary modulation has also been demonstrated in this transmitter using RF signal processing.

articleTitle: Hybrid centralized/distributed approach
abstract: We propose a hybrid centralized/distributed approach to restoration in networks with "intelligent" cross-connects. This approach achieves low restoration capacity and fast restoration speed, while requiring few control plane changes.

articleTitle: Effects of modularity and connectivity on OADM deployment in ring networks
abstract: For a class of optical add/drop multiplexers, we empirically study the effects of port modularity and connectivity on device deployment in ring networks. Designs with greater connectivity and smaller modules allow fewer devices to be deployed.

articleTitle: Interactive design and fabrication of complex FBGs
abstract: Gratings with a single phase shift or several phase shifts are fabricated by over-dithering the phase mask. The gratings are then characterised by measuring their spectral and group delay characteristics and using a reconstruction algorithm.

articleTitle: Novel method of fiber birefringence measurement based on Lyot-Sagnac interferometer
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a simple and accurate optical fiber birefringence measurement method based on all-fiber dual-section Lyot-Sagnac loop interferometer. This method allows measurement of broad birefringence ranges for most common fibers.

articleTitle: The value proposition for bandwidth on demand
abstract: We examine bandwidth on demand (BoD) services from the perspective of customers' use of BoD to most economically satisfy their bandwidth requirements and how those decisions affect the viability of carriers to offer BoD services.

articleTitle: Metro ring node module based on polymeric planar lightwave circuits
abstract: We describe a 4-channel metro ring node module that performs add/drop, protection switching, and power equalization functionalities on a single chip. The worst-case insertion loss is 1.25 dB.

articleTitle: Modeling and verification of FEC performance for optical transmission systems using a proposed uniformly quantized symbol error probability model
abstract: We investigate estimation of BER for optical transmission systems with forward error correction coding using a proposed uniformly quantized symbol error probability model. This model ha been verified by the measurement and Monte Carlo simulations.

articleTitle: Implementation of statistical lambda multiplexing network (SLAMNet)o0
abstract: This paper discusses implementation of a novel signaling-free DWDM network architecture that provides multiwavelength service. In the service, the number of assigned wavelengths is dynamically modified according to the volume of traffic on a best-effort basis.

articleTitle: Silica/air-clad dual-core tapered fiber for polarized supercontinuum generation
abstract: We report the generation of a polarized supercontinuum using a specially fabricated silica/air-clad dual-core tapered fiber. Output spectra cover range of 400-1220 nm at femtosecond Ti:sapphire laser pump with the pulse energy 0.6 nJ.

articleTitle: Phase-coding OCDM using fiber-Bragg-grating with enlarged signal pulse width
abstract: We evaluate correlation characteristics for phase-coding scheme utilizing fiber-Bragg-gratings as encoder/decoder. From the results, we confirmed that channel discrimination is sufficiently capable with the enlarged pulse width 4 times longer than chip duration.

articleTitle: Insertion loss model and input/output losses of single-stage optical cross-connects
abstract: We propose and demonstrate an effective model of the insertion loss of single-stage optical cross-connects, which has application to improve the speed and quality of connection training, to reduce the size of the loss table, and to facilitate maintenance.

articleTitle: Is PMD compensation really useful?
abstract: We compare the benefit of optical PMD compensation relative to improving the PMD tolerance by reducing system reach. PMDCs are found to have value in 10 and 40 Gb/s systems only for a limited range of the fiber PMD parameter.

articleTitle: Fiber Bragg grating pair interferometer sensor with enhanced multiplexing capacity
abstract: A new technique monitoring and multiplexing FBG pair interferometer sensors with linear chirped fiber laser is investigated. It demonstrates the enhanced multiplexing capacity over a conventional WDM FBG sensor system by allowing multiple sensors to share the same optical bandwidth. It is concluded that the sensing elements are low-finesse Fabry-Perot interferometers formed using Bragg grating mirrors with similar spectral characteristics. Multiplexing of two interferometers of different lengths with a linear chirped erbium-doped fiber laser has been demonstrated. Their signals are distinguished through convolution with appropriately matched reference waveforms, even though the reflectance spectra for the FBGs for the two sensors overlap over a wide temperature range.

articleTitle: A reformulation of network design: replacing the uncertain traffic matrix, by a web of linear relations, and its implications
abstract: We describe a new formulation of network design, where we have replaced the traffic matrix by a web of linear relations. The formulation is more powerful compared to the traditional formulation, and this is explored in detail in this paper.

articleTitle: Dual-wavelength transmitter for enhanced video performance over a passive optical network
abstract: RF carriers containing analog and/or digital video content drive a LiNbO/sub 3/ modulator fed by two closely spaced (/spl Delta//spl lambda/=1.6 nm) DFB lasers. This decreases the effective RIN at the receiver by 3 dB and improves the SBS suppression by 3 dB.

articleTitle: 24 channels/spl times/10 GHz spectrally sliced pulse source based on spectral broadening in a highly nonlinear holey fiber
abstract: We demonstrate a multiwavelength pulse source which utilizes supercontinuum generated in a normally dispersive holey fiber and spectral slicing in an arrayed waveguide grating. All channels exhibit almost constant pulse width and excellent noise properties, as verified by bit-error-rate measurements.

articleTitle: Monolithic integration of a semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA) and a high-speed waveguide p-i-n photodiode using asymmetric twin-waveguide technology
abstract: An optical mode transformer, semiconductor optical amplifier, and waveguide photodiode are monolithically integrated without regrowth using separately optimized materials based on asymmetric twin-waveguide technology. The device shows a peak responsivity of 11 A/W and a 3 dB electrical bandwidth of 36 GHz.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact multichannel optical components based on PLC technologies
abstract: We propose multichannel based on PLC and MEMS technologies. 12 channel optical switch arrays and VOA arrays have been successfully developed by integrating 2/spl times/2 cross type and MEMS micro-mirrors connected together by flip chip bonding.

articleTitle: Polarization state rotation filtering for single sideband generation and carrier suppression using a variable DGD element
abstract: We demonstrate a novel, flexible method to generate single sideband subcarrier multiplexed signals using a DGD element and polarizer. We achieve tunable carrier suppression and SSB generation with suppression ratios=35 dB.

articleTitle: Effects of partially polarized noise in a receiver
abstract: We compare back-to-back experiments to an accurate receiver model and an analytical formula for the Q-factor distribution. We show that even for a fixed SNR, partially polarized noise can cause a large variation in system performance.

articleTitle: Field demonstration of all optical in-line wavelength conversion in a WDM 40 Gbit/s dispersion managed link using a polarization insensitive Ti:PPLN converter
abstract: All optical in line wavelength conversion and rerouting is demonstrated in a 5/spl times/100 km WDM field trial using a polarization insensitive Ti:PPLN converter. No penalty with respect to the 40 Gbit/s unconverted channels is reported.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characterization of low loss heterostructured photonic crystal waveguides
abstract: We report a fiber butt-jointable Ta/sub 2/O/sub 5//SiO/sub 2/ photonic crystal waveguide with a record low-loss (0.56 dB/mm). The waveguide has a heterostructure and is fabricated by the autocloning technology. Details are described.

articleTitle: Dynamic gain equalization based on electro-optic filtering in periodically-poled (LiNbO/sub 3/)
abstract: A cascade of electro-optically controlled filters in periodically-poled LiNbO/sub 3/ is used for dynamic gain equalization in DWDM systems. A dynamic gain equalizer with 3.2 dB insertion loss and <0.2 dB BER penalty was experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Analysis of stress in the fiber-array with FEM
abstract: The stress in the fiber-array makes it segregated slowly. This paper deals with the analysis of stress in the fiber-array according to the different epoxy thickness and length. We considered two sorts of fiber-arrays that have 127/250 /spl mu/m channel spacing respectively.

articleTitle: Dispersion-managed fiber with low chromatic dispersion slope
abstract: A dispersion-balanced fiber exhibiting a low chromatic dispersion slope (<0.015 ps/nm/sup 2//km at 1550 nm) was obtained by longitudinally changing the radial dimension of a refractive index profile. We report theoretical and experimental results and trade-offs between effective-area and cable ability aspects.

articleTitle: High-speed high-saturation-current InP/In/sub 0.53/Ga/sub 0.47/As photodiode with partially depleted absorber
abstract: A high saturation current InGaAs photodiode with a partially depleted absorber is demonstrated. Less than 0.5 dB compression is observed in a 6-/spl mu/m diameter photodiode ar 20 mA and 45 GHz. The measured responsivity is 0.6 A/W.

articleTitle: Switchable thin film add/drop filter
abstract: A five-cavity, 117 layer, 200 GHz thin film add/drop filter fabricated from combined dielectric/semiconductor materials is thermo-optically switched between transmission and reflection at a fixed channel 1548.3 nm with a contrast ratio 18.4 dB.

articleTitle: Simple PMD compensator with higher order PMD mitigation
abstract: We suggest a novel simple PMD compensator with higher order PMD mitigation. We have configured the PMDC using two original polarization controllers and a power monitor and tested the operation in 10 G-NRZ evaluation system.

articleTitle: Ultra low-loss waveguides of 0.12 dB/cm directly written in pure silica glass by femtosecond laser pulses
abstract: Ultra low-loss of 0.12 dB/cm at 1580 nm was achieved for directly written waveguides in pure silica glass using femto-second laser for the first time as far as we know. A three-dimensionally structured optical splitter was also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Spectral and noise characteristics of Fabry-perot and DFB 14xx nm InGaAs/InP pump lasers for Raman and Er-doped fiber amplifiers
abstract: 14xx nm InGaAsP/InP DFB and Fabry-Perot ridge waveguide lasers with comparable performance were fabricated. Spectral and noise characteristics of these devices are compared and contrasted. Single frequency and multifrequency DFB devices display low RIN values of -165 dB/Hz.

articleTitle: Designing the dispersion for optimum supercontinuum bandwidth using picosecond pulses
abstract: Generation of a 800nm wide within 20dB super-continuum with picosecond pulses is possible by proper design of the dispersion to enhance the efficiency of the direct degenerate four-wave-mixing. The robustness to random fluctuations along the fiber is also improved.

articleTitle: Polarization dependent gain in fiber Raman amplifiers: effect of PMD and pump states of polarization
abstract: We report results of experiments and theoretical model on decrease polarization dependence of the Raman amplification in single-mode fibers with different PMD by means of an appropriate variation of the state of polarization (SOP) of pump source.

articleTitle: Unimpaired idler generation in four-band amplifiers using co- and counterphased modulation technique
abstract: Two-pump parametric amplifiers are characterized by the existence of four distinct amplification bands. A new technique allows for unimpaired wavelength conversion and does not require conventional pump phase delay management.

articleTitle: Ultrafast optical demultiplexing, regeneration, and wavelength-conversion with symmetric-Mach-Zehnder all-optical switches
abstract: We demonstrate various types of ultrafast optical signal processing with symmetric-Mach-Zehnder all-optical switches. We have achieved error-free 336-Gb/s demultiplexing, penalty-free, error-free 84-Gb/s pulse regeneration, and error-free 168-Gb/s wavelength conversion.

articleTitle: Polarization-independent optical sampling system using two-path configuration
abstract: We have successfully developed a polarization-independent optical sampling system using a two-path configuration based on sum-frequency generation. In this system, the polarization dependency was less than 3.5 % from 1520 to 1620 nm.

articleTitle: Tunable dispersion slope compensator with a chirped fiber grating for 160-Gb/s RZ transmissions
abstract: We have developed the tunable dispersion slope compensator with a chirped fiber grating for 160-Gb/s transmissions. We successfully demonstrated the dispersion slope change from -20 ps/nm/sup 2/ to +20 ps/nm/sup 2/ and ability of this dispersion slope compensation in 160-Gb/s RZ transmissions.

articleTitle: Quantitative experimental study of intra-channel nonlinear timing jitter in a 10 Gb/s terrestrial WDM return-to-zero system
abstract: Using a recirculating loop, we measure nonlinearly-induced timing jitter at different transmission distances for different amounts of pre-compensation. Within each sub-band, we achieve error-free transmission using the same pre-compensation for all channels at all distances up to 5000 km.

articleTitle: From 2,100 km to 2,700 km distance using phase-shaped binary transmission at 6.3 Tbit/s capacity
abstract: The distance of our recent 6 Tb/s transmission experiment was increased by fine adjustment of dispersion management and by decreasing the signal power by 1 dB, yielding a record 17 Pbit/s.km capacity/spl times/distance product for terrestrial systems.

articleTitle: A low-loss, compact wide-FSR-AWG using SiON planar lightwave circuit technology
abstract: Wide FSR of 80 nm with SiON high-/spl Delta/ technology reduced loss variation among channels of a 40-channel AWG to 0.6 dB with low insertion-loss of less than 2.2 dB for all channels without chip-size enlargement.

articleTitle: Experimental statistical assessment of XPM impact on optical PMD compensator efficiency
abstract: In this paper, we report experiments on the statistical assessment of the reduction of PMD mitigator efficiency in presence of XPM effects. The XPM-induced depolarization limits compensation in polarization dispersive ultra-long haul system at 10 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Solid-core photonic bandgap fiber with large anomalous dispersion
abstract: For the first time, a theoretical investigation is performed for a novel solid-core photonic band-gap fiber design. The design features large positive waveguide dispersion, which enables an anomalous dispersion of up to D=600 ps/km/nm at /spl lambda/=1.55 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Monitoring chromatic dispersion and PMD impairments in optical differential phaseshift-keyed (DPSK) systems
abstract: We simulate and measure chromatic dispersion and polarization mode dispersion impairments, and demonstrate their monitoring by measuring clock tone power and degree of polarization in DPSK and RZ-DPSK systems.

articleTitle: On channel models for predicting soft-decision error correction performance in optically amplified systems
abstract: We investigate three channel models for optically amplified systems employing soft-decision decoding. We show that the additive white Gaussian noise model can be a proper model for error-correction performance prediction but not for error-correction implementation in noise-limited optical fiber channels.

articleTitle: Optical 3R regeneration in 40 Gbit/s pseudo-linear transmission systems
abstract: Transmission over one million kilometers of nonzero dispersion fiber is achieved using optical 3R regeneration. Regeneration is obtained using synchronous modulation combined with 2R regeneration using self-phase modulation in highly nonlinear fiber and subsequent filtering.

articleTitle: Cross-connect-type wavelength add-drop node with integrated band muxes, interleavers, and monitor
abstract: We integrated a cross-connect-type add-drop, de-interleaver, interleaver, combiner, and variable attenuators on one silica waveguide chip and a band demux, band mux, and optical monitor on another to create a potentially low-startup-cost node.

articleTitle: Improved all-silica endlessly single-mode photonic crystal fiber
abstract: A novel endlessly single-mode photonic crystal fiber with a triangular core is proposed and fabricated. Compared to conventional designs having a hexagonal core, the fiber has improved robustness when scaled to large structures.

articleTitle: A 42.7-Gb/s integrated balanced optical front end with record sensitivity
abstract: We have demonstrated a record sensitivity of -36.9 dBm (39 photons/bit) for a BER of 10/sup -9/ at 42.7-Gb/s using an integrated balanced optical front end. Results were obtained using optical preamplification of RZ-DPSK modulation and an external delay-interferometer. The OSNR requirement was measured to be 17.0 dB in a 0.1 nm bandwidth.

articleTitle: In-line chromatic dispersion monitoring using optically-added phase modulate in-band for 10 Gb/s system
abstract: We demonstrate a novel in-line dispersion monitoring technique using phase modulated in-band subcarrier tones. Our technique has no subcarrier-subcarrier tones. Our technique has no subcarrier to-data crosstalk, high sensitivity, and large monitoring range. A >3400 ps/nm monitoring range and <9 (ps/nm)/dB sensitivity are shown for a 10-Gb/systm.

articleTitle: Availability optimization of static path-protected WDM networks
abstract: We developed a heuristic procedure to optimize wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) networks with reliability as objective function. Optimization experiments have been carried out on a case study network, exploring the trade-off between network cost and reliability.

articleTitle: 10 Gb/s soliton generation for ULH transmission using a wideband GaAs pHemt amplifier
abstract: A novel technique of generating 10 Gb/s soliton data using a wideband GaAs pHemt amplifier is demonstrated and applied in a 10G transmission experiment. Bit-error-rate better than FEC threshold is achieved over 4000km.

articleTitle: OSNR margin assessment for optical transmissions in the nonlinear regime with forward error correction
abstract: We study numerically and experimentally the OSNR margin of high-speed transmissions in the nonlinear regime. It is found that the actual FEC coding gains can be much larger than those quoted for the linear case.

articleTitle: Field trial of end-to-end OC-768 transmission using 9 WDM channels over 1000 km of installed fiber
abstract: We report the first end-to-end OC-768 transmission over 1000 km of installed fiber, using an all-Raman DWDM system with OC-768 intra-office client interfaces. Error-free transmission with more than 8 dB of OSNR margin was achieved.

articleTitle: A surface and bulk micromachined angular vertical combdrive for scanning micromirrors
abstract: We present a high performance scanning micromirror with angular vertical comb actuators realized by combining MUMPs with a 3-mask deep-reactive-ion-etching post process. A DC scan angle of /spl plusmn/4/spl deg/ (mechanical) is achieved at 40 V.

articleTitle: Benefits of restoration signaling message aggregation
abstract: Signaling aggregation provides a practical approach to fast failure recovery in path-based restoration schemes. This paper proposes several signaling aggregation schemes and demonstrates their potential for improving restoration performance compared with schemes without aggregation.

articleTitle: High-speed wavelength switching in wavelength conversion using spectral duplication
abstract: Wavelength conversion is achieved by taking one signal with an AWG from the multiwavelength signals generated by sinusoidal intensity and phase modulation. High-speed wavelength switching of ns order is attained using SOA gate switches.

articleTitle: Anomalous refractive index changes in optical fibers resulting from frozen-in viscoelastic strain
abstract: Important, yet previously overlooked, anomalous optical fiber refractive index changes result from frozen-in viscoelastic strains, which are distinct from residual elastic strains. These index changes affect fiber design, measurement, and splicing, and can be harnessed to serve as the basis for novel fiber devices.

articleTitle: Ultra low coherent crosstalk, high port-count free-space wavelength router
abstract: A low loss 80/spl times/80 port wavelength router is reported for the first time. The large port count is achieved through low background crosstalk using a concave diffraction grating and fibre-pigtailed concentrator arrays with lowest reported coherent crosstalk levels to date.

articleTitle: Phase-only sampling for fabrication and design of high channel-count fiber Bragg gratings
abstract: Fiber Bragg gratings with phase-only superstructure ('sampling') are shown to enable the fabrication of large channel counts with adequate reflectivity. Grating fabrication is facilitated by the standard side-writing technique, where the entire sampling pattern is included in a precise, lithographically prepared phase mask. Fiber Bragg gratings (FBGs) have recently seen application as a new class of extremely versatile devices to address a wide variety of challenges of present and future wavelength division multiplexed (WDM) systems.

articleTitle: Local optimization of shared backup channels in optical mesh networks
abstract: This paper illustrates the complexity of assigning backup-channels in shared-mesh-protected optical networks. We propose a distributed recurring method to solve this problem, and show that substantial savings are achievable.

articleTitle: 1.3μm EAM-integrated DFB lasers for 40 Gb/s very-short-reach application
abstract: 1.3μm EAM-DFBs for 40 Gb/s VSR applications have been developed. 40 Gb/s NRZ operation with 9.77 dB extinction ratio have been successfully achieved and no eye degradation was observed after 2 km SSMF transmission.

articleTitle: Effects of the nonlinearly-induced timing and amplitude jitter on the performance of different modulation formats in WDM optical fiber communications systems
abstract: We compare the CRZ, RZ, and NRZ modulation formats in WDM systems. We identify the physical phenomena responsible for the performance advantages and disadvantages of these formats during transmission and in the receiver.

articleTitle: Narrow band coupler based on one-dimensional Bragg reflection waveguide
abstract: The strong difference between the dispersion of a Bragg reflection waveguide and a channel waveguide is used to create a narrow band coupler. The principle of operation is confirmed with experimental results showing 0.8nm bandwidth for a 2.2mm long coupler.

articleTitle: Terabit/s field trial over the first installed dispersion-flattened transpacific system
abstract: We present results of a successful field trial at 96 /spl times/ 12.3 Gb/s per fiber over the first installed dispersion-flattened transpacific system, 8991-km long, part of the Tyco Global Network/sup /spl trade//, plus experimental results for 128 /spl times/ 12.3 Gb/s over the same path.

articleTitle: WDM routing with low cross-talk in the data vortex packet switching fabric
abstract: Routing of 10 Gbit/sec optical packets is demonstrated with WDM-encoded header bits. The traffic flow control mechanism uniquely reduces latency and simplifies packet processing. Significantly lower cross-talk is obtained using linear optical amplifier switching gates.

articleTitle: A simple formula for the degree of polarization degraded by XPM and its experimental validation
abstract: We derive a closed-form expression for the DOP of polarized signals affected by XPM, in a modulated pump-probe scheme. Results are checked against simulations and experiments on a dispersion managed 3 /spl times/100 km link.

articleTitle: Phase modulation schemes for improving intra-channel nonlinear tolerance in 40 Gbit/s transmission
abstract: Several schemes for suppressing intra-channel nonlinearities by introducing phase shifts between pulses are compared. Simulations and experiments show that sinusoidal phase modulation at 10 GHz provides a simple and effective means for improving the nonlinear tolerance in 40 Gbit/s transmission.

articleTitle: Time resolved characterization of the polarization state of optical pulses
abstract: A technique to determine the time evolution of the polarization state within an optical pulse is described and example measurements of pulses affected by polarization-mode dispersion are presented.

articleTitle: New all 2-inch manufacturable high performance evanescent coupled waveguide photodiodes with etched mirrors for 40 Gb/s optical receivers
abstract: Evanescent PIN photodiodes are fabricated using all 2"-InP processing including on-wafer mirrors and coatings. 0.73 A/W responsivity at 1.55 /spl mu/m, -1 dB vertical coupling tolerance of 2.2 /spl mu/m and 47 GHz bandwidth are simultaneously demonstrated.

articleTitle: All-optical wavelength converter based on a pulse reformatting optical filter
abstract: We demonstrate a novel all-optical wavelength converter based on a pulse reformatting optical filter. A realization within a MEMS switch allows simultaneous 40 Gb/s wavelength conversion, switching and format conversion. The device outperforms current schemes with respect to input-power requirements, input-power dynamic range and signal quality.

articleTitle: Gain variation of Raman amplifier in birefringent fiber
abstract: We developed a simple analytical expression for the statistics of the polarization-dependent gain in a co-pumped Raman amplifier. Using this analysis, we evaluated the effects of PMD, wavelength difference between pump and signal, and pump loss on the polarization-dependent gain.

articleTitle: Polarization dependent parametric gain in amplifiers with orthogonally multiplexed optical pumps
abstract: We show that the orthogonal pump configuration does not guarantee the polarization insensitive operation of two-pump parametric amplifiers. Experimental observations are made with various lengths of highly nonlinear optical fiber to demonstrate the polarization dependence of the parametric gain.

articleTitle: Experimental observation of local birefringence and axis rotation in spun fibers on a centimetric scale
abstract: We have measured the evolution of local birefringence along spun fiber samples, with a centimeter resolution scale. Experimental results confirm that the spinning-induced rotation of local birefringence axes reduces the effective fiber birefringence.

articleTitle: The road towards all-optical networks
abstract: This paper describes the key issues to implement transparent DWDM networks. A promising solution is the multigranularity approach with transparent waveband switching and regenerating wavelength grooming. Applications in metropolitan and backbone optical networks are given.

articleTitle: A novel bidirectional wavelength division multiplexed passive optical network with 1:1 protection
abstract: We propose a novel network architecture for WDM-PON which offers 1:1 protection capability. In case of any fiber cut between remote node and ONUs, the affected ONU can re-route the wavelength channels via the adjacent ONU.

articleTitle: TCP-aware active congestion control in optical packet-switched networks
abstract: This paper proposes a TCP-aware active congestion control architecture in OPS networks and investigates the performance improvement. Simulation results indicate that the proposed scheme can significantly reduce packet-loss rate and efficiently enhance the network throughput.

articleTitle: Extra-broadband and highly efficient short length Bi/sub 2/O/sub 3/-based EDF
abstract: We demonstrated the 3-dB down bandwidth of 75 nm with average output power over 20 dBm for single-stage operation with Bi/sub 2/O/sub 3/-based EDF. Its max power conversion efficiency was 39 % at 1560 nm.

articleTitle: Fiber Bragg gratings (FBG) made with a phase mask and 800 nm femtosecond radiation
abstract: FBG's were written in SMF-28 fiber, without fiber sensitization, using 800 nm 120 fs pulses and a phase mask (peak intensities: 1.2/spl times/10/sup 13/ W/cm/sup 2/). Gratings with /spl Delta/n=1.85/spl times/10/sup -3/ and low polarization dependence were stable at 500/spl deg/C.

articleTitle: Multistage architectures for optical packet switching using SOA-based broadcast-and-select switches
abstract: Optical packet/burst switches can be scaled to high port counts using multistage architectures. To reduce the number of switching elements in SOA-based broadcast-and-select architectures, we deploy only a few stages while exploiting the WDM dimension.

articleTitle: Duration-tunable 100-GHz sub-picosecond soliton train generation through adiabatic Raman amplification in conjunction with soliton reshaping
abstract: We demonstrate generation of 100-GHz soliton train with tunability of temporal duration from 0.84 to 2.1 ps by adiabatic Raman amplification with soliton reshaping, while keeping near transform-limit, low pedestal level and low stimulated Brillouin scattering.

articleTitle: OTDM demultiplexer based on XPM-induced wavelength shifting in highly nonlinear fiber
abstract: Demultiplexing of 160 Gb/s OTDM data to 10 Gb/s has been demonstrated with a 100 m highly nonlinear fiber based all-optical demultiplexer. The scheme employs cross-phase modulation induced wavelength shifting with subsequent optical filtering.

articleTitle: Air-guidance over 345m large-core photonic bandgap fiber
abstract: For development of hollow-core transmission fibers the realizable fibers lengths, bandwidth, characterization and compatibility with standard technology are important issues. We report record-length air-guiding fiber, spectral properties, splicing, and OTDR measurements.

articleTitle: Photonic integrated devices for high speed signal processing and switching
abstract: We describe some of our recent results on semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA)-based integrated devices for signal processing and switching: a WDM channel selector and a wavelength converter will be discussed.

articleTitle: 160 Gbit/s clock recovery with electro-optical PLL using a bidirectionally operated electroabsorption modulator as phase comparator
abstract: A 10 GHz clock recovery from a 160 Gb/s data signal is demonstrated using a bidirectionally operated electroabsorption modulator (EAM). Employing a differential detection scheme, excellent locking stability is achieved. The recovered clock allows error-free 160 Gb/s to 10 Gb/s demultiplexing with no penalty.

articleTitle: The first field trial of a wavelength routing WDM full-mesh network system (AWG-STAR) in a metropolitan/local area
abstract: We describe the first field trial of a secure wavelength routing full-mesh WDM (AWG-STAR) network for citywide local-administration in Japan. A 32/spl times/32 AWG-router and five WDM nodes with a management system of 43 nodes were installed in a downtown area.

articleTitle: Applying GMPLS on optical Ethernet: a hybrid approach
abstract: A new hybrid scheme that combines GMPLS QoS features with merged reconfigurable optical and Ethernet layer is proposed. It achieves a highly efficient and cost-effective optical Ethernet system viable for LAN/MAN/WAN. A testbed based on this scheme is also presented.

articleTitle: 100/spl deg/C, 10-Gb/s direct modulation with a low operation current of 1.3-/spl mu/m AlGaInAs buried heterostructure DFB laser diodes
abstract: 1.3-/spl mu/m AlGaInAs BH DFB laser diodes have been developed for the first time. 100/spl deg/C, 10-Gb/s operation and transmission over 16 km of SMF were demonstrated with an 80-mA operating current and a 42-mA/sub p-p/ modulation current.

articleTitle: High dynamic range characterization of waveform and frequency-chirp of pico-second pulses based on the precise measurement of group delay in optical frequency domain
abstract: We propose a technique to characterize pico-second pulses based on the precise measurement of group-delay in the optical frequency domain. In the experiment, a high dynamic range of over 46 dB is achieved by drift cancellation.

articleTitle: 70GHz-spaced 40 x 42.7 Gbit/s transmission over 8700 km using CS-RZ DPSK signal, all-Raman repeaters and symmetrically dispersion-managed fiber span
abstract: 70GHz-spaced 40 x 42.7 Gbit/s pre-filtered CS-RZ DPSK signals have been successfully transmitted over 8700 km for the first time, using all-Raman repeaters, "ABA" dispersion map and an ETDM receiver. Long-term stability was also confirmed with low-speed polarization scrambling and without using PMD compensation.

articleTitle: Dispersion management with long-length fiber Bragg gratings
abstract: Grating fabrication technology has advanced considerably over the past several years. Grating-based dispersion management modules exist that yield low system power penalties and have proper thermal management, mechanical reliability, and packaging.

articleTitle: FWM-assisted Raman laser for second-order Raman pumping
abstract: By enabling four-wave-mixing process within the cavity, a new type of Raman fiber laser for second-order pumping applications is demonstrated, exhibiting high stability down to a few milliwatts for the seed (1428 nm).

articleTitle: An optical millimeter wave fiber laser
abstract: Optical millimeter wave generation is realized using dual polarization modes operation from a co-located dual distributed feedback fiber laser configuration. A narrow linewidth optical millimeter wave signal at 32.5 GHz is demonstrated without using complex control mechanism.

articleTitle: BER performance of an optical fast frequency-hopping CDMA system with multiple simultaneous users
abstract: We report the bit error rate (BER) performance of an optical fast frequency-hopping CDMA system for up to 16 simultaneous users. Previous predictions of BER are shown to be overly pessimistic (beat noise limited) or optimistic (interference limited).

articleTitle: Timing jitter and amplitude noise reduction by a chirped pulsed-pump fiber OPA
abstract: A novel optical pulse reshaping scheme is proposed to reduce timing jitter and amplitude noise. Sensitivity improvement of 2.6 dB was demonstrated by the temporal lens effect realized by a linearly-chirped pulsed-pump optical parametric amplifier followed by optimum dispersion.

articleTitle: Leakage losses in photonic crystal fibers
abstract: The reduction of leakage losses is a key issue for PCF optical applications. The finite elements provide a powerful tool for low loss fiber design and foresee losses of the same order of standard fibers.

articleTitle: Uncooled injection-locked 1.55 /spl mu/m tunable VCSEL as DWDM transmitter
abstract: We study the temperature effects on injection-locked VCSELs for use in WDM transmitters. We show that injection-locking can be used to lock an uncooled VCSEL to the WDM grid while improving the modulation performance.

articleTitle: Limiting sharing on protection channels in mesh optical networks
abstract: We examine two approaches in shared mesh restoration to limiting the number of lightpaths protected by a shared-channel. The goal is to prevent shared-channels from protecting a large number of lightpaths without significantly increasing protection capacity.

articleTitle: Signal-to-noise ratio monitoring of optical data using narrowband RF analysis at the half-clock frequency
abstract: A novel technique for monitoring the in-band SNR of an optical data channel is demonstrated. The technique utilizes an inherent symmetry present the RF spectrum at half the data clock frequency, is highly sensitive and potentially low-cost.

articleTitle: Defining all-optical networking and assessing its benefits in metro, regional and backbone networks
abstract: Conflicting marketing messages from vendors pro and con all-optical networks have led to some confusion in this area. This paper attempts to clarify the issue by suggesting some formal definitions of all-optical networking, and assessing its benefits in metro, regional and backbone networks.

articleTitle: Cross talk in a fibre parametric wavelength converter
abstract: The cross talk in a fibre parametric wavelength converter has been modeled. The cross talk is generated, which is seeded by four wave mixing and then amplified by the parametric gain.

articleTitle: Experimental importance sampling using a 3-section PMD emulator with programmable DGD elements
abstract: We experimentally employ importance sampling techniques using three programmable differential group delay (DGD) elements to obtain rare polarization mode dispersion (PMD) events with probabilities as low as 10/sup -24/ with only 1000 random samples. Our method does not require deterministic control of the polarization coupling between sections.

articleTitle: Fast and accurate characterization of fiber Bragg gratings with high spatial and spectral resolution
abstract: The complex reflectivity of fiber Bragg gratings is measured by optical frequency-domain reflectometry. By inverse scattering the complex coupling coefficient is reconstructed. A spatial resolution of 20 nm is achieved, while measurement time is only a few seconds.

articleTitle: Error-free all-optical add-drop multiplexing at 160 Gbit/s
abstract: We report an all-optical add-drop multiplexer based on gain-transparent operation of a semiconductor optical amplifier in a novel geometry. Error-free operation at 160 Gbit/s is demonstrated for all channels.

articleTitle: Adaptive electronic linearization of fiber optic links
abstract: Nonlinearity in electrical-to-optical conversion limits dynamic range for transmitting analog and multilevel signals over fiber optic channel. We describe CMOS predistortion linearizer which extends dynamic range of direct and externally modulated links by suppressing both 2nd and 3rd order distortions.

articleTitle: Polarization tracking receiver demonstration over transoceanic distance
abstract: We demonstrated the feasibility of a polarization tracking receiver in a 6500 km straight line transmission experiment. This is the first transoceanic length DWDM demonstration using a fully automatic polarization tracker producing a record setting 66 % spectral efficiency for 10 Gb/s transmission.

articleTitle: High power C-band semiconductor booster optical amplifier
abstract: A semiconductor booster optical amplifier chip with a saturation power of 20.2 dBm has been demonstrated to operate over the whole C-band. This booster amplifier was used in 10 Gb/s propagation experiment over 80 km of single mode fiber.

articleTitle: Coherent PMD and programmable PMD generation
abstract: Completely predictable polarization mode dispersion sources can be built once the three fundamental factors of polarization mode dispersion are controlled. Those factors are the stage delay, the Stokes orientation of the stage's birefringent axis, and the stage's birefringent phase.

articleTitle: Nonlinear servo control of MEMS mirrors and their performance in a large port-count optical switch
abstract: We demonstrate full closed-loop control of electrostatically actuated double-gimbaled MEMS mirrors and use them in a free space optical cross-connect with switching times of less than 10 ms, and optical power stability of better than 0.2 dB.

articleTitle: Bi-directional transmission of broadband 5.2 GHz wireless signals over fibre using a multiple-quantum-well asymmetric Fabry-Perot modulator/photodetector
abstract: We report for the first time broadband DPSK 5.2 GHz wireless over fibre transmission using a normal-incidence reflective InGaAsP/InGaAsP MQW AFPM as both modulator and photodetector for passive picocell applications.

articleTitle: Leakage losses in segmented cladding fibers
abstract: Like holey fibers, segmented cladding fibers are leaky structures. By calculating the leakage losses of two different large-core segmented cladding fiber designs by a combination of radial-effective index method (REIM) and transverse matrix method (TMM), the principle of effective single-mode operation with such fibers is established.

articleTitle: Instability in Raman amplifiers caused by distributed Rayleigh reflection
abstract: We observed instability in Raman optical amplifiers caused by the Raman gain and the cavity between two mirrors formed by distributed Rayleigh reflection. Threshold pump power for the instability and limitation imposed on Raman amplifiers are derived and discussed.

articleTitle: 10 Gb/s high power electro-absorption modulated laser monolithically integrated with a semiconductor optical amplifier for transmission over 80 km
abstract: High average output power over +3 dBm was obtained in 10 Gb/s electro-absorption modulated laser for transmission over 80 km by amplifying the modulated signals through monolithically integrated semiconductor optical amplifier, for the first time to our knowledge.

articleTitle: 115/spl deg/C, 12.5-Gb/s direct modulation of 1.3-/spl mu/m InGaAlAs-MQW RWG DFB laser with notch-free grating structure for datacom applications
abstract: Direct modulation at 12.5 Gb/s of 1.3-/spl mu/m DFB RWG lasers with low-resistance notch-free gratings running at 115/spl deg/C is experimentally demonstrated, for the first time. Moreover, 10-Gb/s modulated transmission over 30 km at 115/spl deg/C was achieved.

articleTitle: PMD effects in fiber-based Raman amplifiers
abstract: We develop a vector theory to study the PMD effects on Raman amplification and use it to show that PMD not only makes the Raman gain to depend on signal polarization but also induces large fluctuations in the amplified signal.

articleTitle: The effects of distributed PMD, PDL, and loop scrambling on BER distributions in a recirculating loop used to emulate long-haul terrestrial transmission
abstract: We demonstrate that, even for a long-haul recirculating loop system with low-PMD fiber, loop-synchronous polarization scrambling must be used for the performance to resemble that in a straight-line system. Otherwise, the BER can vary over four orders of magnitude.

articleTitle: Applying optical transparency to a heterogeneous pan-European network
abstract: Applying an innovative experimental tool to a continental scale network, we demonstrate that up to 99.7% of the connections of a hybrid heterogeneous network may be established transparently at 10 Gbit/s with the simplest physical design.

articleTitle: Tunable dispersion compensation at 10 Gb/s and 40 Gb/s using multicavity all-pass etalons
abstract: Our tunable dispersion compensator devices based on multiple cavity all-pass etalons are designed to compensate all channels throughout the C- and L-bands and appropriate for 10 Gb/s and 40 Gb/s applications. Detailed characterization of devices and system experimental results will be presented.

articleTitle: Economic benefits of transparent OXC networks as compared to long systems with OADMs
abstract: Quantitative analysis shows that a transparent OXC network provides only up to 5% improvements in cost savings as compared to long systems with OADMs. Other unique advantages for transparent networks need to be proven-in before they are widely adopted.

articleTitle: Key enabling optical technologies for future networks
abstract: The recent advances in PLC technologies warrant the realization of optical path networking, and new cutting-edge technologies such as super-continuum optical sources and photonic crystal fibers are now emerging to play important roles.

articleTitle: Electronic equalization for extending the reach of electro-absorption modulator based transponders
abstract: We demonstrate the use of electronic equalization to improve the performance of electro-absorption modulators. We show that a transmitter designed for 40 km reach applications can be extended beyond 75 km when assisted by electronic equalization.

articleTitle: Photonic random access memory using serial-to-parallel and parallel-to-serial conversion
abstract: A novel photonic random access memory uses all-optical serial-to-parallel and electrical parallel-to-optical serial conversion, together with an optical clock-pulse generator and a silicon-based memory, and is demonstrated for 40-Gbit/s 16-bit burst optical packets.

articleTitle: A bottom-up traffic demand model for long haul and metropolitan optical networks
abstract: A bottom-up traffic model featuring traffic demand estimations, application-specific growth projections and detailed demand-to-working network capacity conversion factors is described and applied to both long haul and metropolitan networks (with >85% accuracy).

articleTitle: Resonant gain enhancement induced by pump RIN transfer in distributed Raman amplifiers
abstract: An analytical solution is presented, which describes the resonant gain enhancement induced by pump RIN transfer in distributed Raman amplifiers. It helps understanding the experimentally observed ASE bump build-up which can degrade system performance in NZ-DS fibers.

articleTitle: 50 GHz WDM sources and its uplink system using two-mode injection-locked Fabry-Perot lasers and electro-absorption modulator for millimeter-wave radio-on-fiber communications
abstract: Optical generation of 50 GHz mm-wave WDM sources with low phase noise, low fiber dispersion, and wide tunable range is investigated for radio-on-fiber system. Uplink signal transmission with phase noise of -95 dBc/Hz at 100 kHz is tested.

articleTitle: High-speed, stable and repeatable PMD emulator with tunable statistics
abstract: Using three programmable DGD elements, we experimentally demonstrate a high-speed PMD emulator with tunable statistics and good stability and repeatability. By incorporating in-line polarimeters, a repeatable lookup-table of DGD and 2/sup nd/-order PMD states can be created.

articleTitle: Transmission of 40/spl times/43 Gb/s over 2540 km of SMF with terrestrial 100 km spans using NRZ format
abstract: We demonstrate 100 GHz-spaced 40/spl times/43 Gb/s WDM transmission over 2540 km of SMF fibre in a terrestrial configuration, with combined erbium and Raman amplification and a standard NRZ format. All channels perform better than the enhanced FEC limit.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of the impact of NZDF zero-dispersion wavelength on broadband transmission in Raman-enhanced systems
abstract: Two nonzero dispersion fibers with different zero-dispersion wavelengths (ZDW) were evaluated for C+L-band, Raman-enhanced systems. With an optimized ZDW, 80/spl times/42.7 Gb/s transmission over 800-km can be achieved without forward-error-correction or per-channel post dispersion optimization.

articleTitle: Characteristics of asymmetrically filtered 40 Gbit/s CS-RZ signals
